9001122.en: Will Xingtian's Shield or Xingtian's Axe win in the end? If the Nether Air pours out and corrupts Tree Vault, I will no longer suppress it. The destruction of this world is near.
9001122.ch: 不知最后是干会胜还是戚会胜……若最终冥气汹涌而出侵蚀建木，我便再无压制冥气之力，这八荒的大难之日就不远了。

9001123.en: In short, if the Nether Air is allowed to spread throughout the world, the world will be completely destroyed... Ahem...
9001123.ch: 总之若让冥气扩散到整个八荒，此方世界便彻底沉沦……咳咳……

9001124.en: Goumang's cough suddenly gets violent, and his face pales. It takes him a while to regain his breath.
9001124.ch: 句芒突然咳嗽得十分厉害，脸色因此变得异常难看，好一阵子后，他才平复下来。

9001125.en: You want to go deep into Tian Yuan Mountain, and I, want to completely restrain the Nether Air. In this case, I will help you defeat Xingtian.
9001125.ch: 我不久前才知，你要深入那天元山之中，而我也要彻底遏制这冥气，既然如此，我便助你击败这刑天。

9001126.en: You may think it over, and come to me if you find it possible.
9001126.ch: 你可以认真考虑一番，若觉得事有可为，便来找我。

9001127.en: Goumang... You really have no regard for yourself...
9001127.ch: 句芒……你真的一点都不顾自己的安危么……

9001128.en: We don't have enough time... If we don't act immediately, the world will be destroyed.
9001128.ch: 来不及了……再不行动，只怕八荒将灭。

9001129.en: My friend, don't make me wait too long... Here are some things good for your cultivation. Take them.
9001129.ch: 小友，别让我久等……这有些对你们修炼有益之物，你便拿去吧。

9001130.en: After that, Goumang and Bihong disappear. You find a mountain cave to heal your wounds. After one night, you decide to leave, only to find that someone left a guide at the cave, pointing to somewhere nearby.
9001130.ch: 说完，句芒和碧泓便消失了，你寻了一处山洞疗伤，一夜过后，你便决定离去，竟发现洞口有人留下指引，指向附近的某处地方。

9001131.en: As soon as you leave the mountain cave, a golden, transparent figure with its face unidentified appears in front of you in a flash.
9001131.ch: 你刚出山洞，前方突然光影凝聚，出现出一个不辨面目的金色透明人影猛向你疾扑而来。

9001132.en: You concentrate to enter the realm of Mind Sea, shutting down your senses, which are the obstacles for you to perceive the truth. Meanwhile, you smell a light fragrance spreading out from inside the wood plaque.
9001132.ch: 你凝神进入识海境界，弃去阻碍你觉察真相的五官六感后，你感受到木块之中透出的阵阵幽香。

9001133.en: The fragrance seems to be left by the golden figure...
9001133.ch: 幽香似为金色人影所留……

9001134.en: You follow the fragrance and arrive at a mountain cave.
9001134.ch: 你循异香踪迹找到一处山洞。

9001135.en: Once you are in the cave, a spell appears at the entrance and seals it off.
9001135.ch: 你才进入洞中，穴口突然升起咒文，将你封在其中。

9001137.en: Why are you here again? The Tree Vault doesn't welcome you. Please leave, now.
9001137.ch: 你为何还来这里，建木不欢迎你，还请你离开。

9001138.en: On my way back to the Cultivator Alliance, a golden figure appeared to attack me. After defeating it, I followed the fragrance of the wood plaque with my Mind Sea and arrived at a mountain cave, where an Evergreen appeared to attack me. Don't you have anything to say about these?
9001138.ch: 我回归仙盟途中，有金影攻击于我，击败分身后，我循着掉落木牌的气味，又找到一个山洞，结果山洞之中，偏偏又恰好有一只妖兽攻击于我，这一切，你便没有什么想说的吗？

9001139.en: I don't know what you're talking about...

9001140.en: Mulberry Branch Fragment is very rare. Who else would hold this?
9001140.ch: 扶桑树余屑八荒罕有，除了你，还有谁持有此物？

9001141.ch: 这，这都是你自己的猜测！

9001143.en: Bihong, why do you treat my friend like this? If he is killed, the world will be completely doomed...
9001143.ch: 碧泓，为何要背着我这般对小友？若小友真被你害死，这八荒便彻底没救了……

9001144.en: You, don't you know your situation! Is it worth it to do so...
9001144.ch: 你，你不知道你的情况吗！这样做，值得吗……

9001145.en: There is not much time left for me. If Nether Air continues to spread, the world will be destroyed in one fell swoop...
9001145.ch: 留给我的时间不多了，若冥气继续扩散，整个八荒都将毁于一旦……

9001146.en: Qi... Nether Air... The world. That's all you care about. Everything has its destiny. It's beyond your will...
9001146.ch: 灵气……冥气……八荒，你只会将这些放在心上，但一切生灵都有归宿，不是你能左右的……

9001147.en: It has everything to do with the survival of the world! Someone has to do it. *cough cough*
9001147.ch: 此事关乎八荒存续兴亡，总需有人去做，咳……咳咳……

9001148.en: Goumang starts coughing before he could finish his words. Nether Air spurts out from all over his body, his eyes looking chaotic, and his face distorted. Bihong grabs him and uses her own Energy to suppress Goumang's pain.
9001148.ch: 句芒话才说完，突然咳嗽起来，他全身冒出大量冥气，眼神逐渐混沌，面目变得狰狞，碧泓急忙从旁扶住，同时以灵力为句芒压制痛楚。

9001149.en: You, you go... Goumang is invaded by the Nether Air and couldn't talk to you anymore.
9001149.ch: 你……你走吧……句芒此刻被冥气侵袭，无法再和你说话了。

9001151.en: With that said, she takes Goumang away and is soon out of sight.
9001151.ch: 说完，碧泓便扶着句芒转身离开，片刻消失于你视线之中。

9001152.en: (What is this? It seems to be usable...)

9001153.en: Master, the disciples have all returned. Thanks to you, otherwise the Alliance would be greatly weakened!
9001153.ch: 盟主，那些仙盟弟子皆已回来，此番幸好有盟主，不然仙盟将实力大损，危在旦夕。

9001154.en: Master, a woman in green came from outside the walls and asked me to give this to you.
9001154.ch: 盟主，城墙之外有一名绿衣女子，送来枯枝说要将之交到你手上。

9001155.en: Master, it should be the Mulberry Branch if my eyes are not deceived.
9001155.ch: 盟主，若老身双眼未拙，此物当是扶桑枝吧。

9001156.en: ...So Divine Mulberry Guardian sent this to you to invite you for a chat?
9001156.ch: ……扶桑树守护者将此物交达你手，是希望与你一见？

9001157.en: In front of you is a small grove with green trees and grass, tranquil and calm. Bihong is standing under a tree, looking at the giant tree of Tree Vault in the distance.
9001157.ch: 眼前是一片小小树林，周围绿树碧草，十分清幽，碧泓正抱着双膝坐在一棵树荫底下，抬头看着远方建木巨树。

9001158.en: Goumang's condition is stable now. First of all, I want to apologize for my plotting against you the other day. And then I want to tell you about our story in Chi You.
9001158.ch: 句芒情形已经稳定下来……请你过来一是为了向当日袭你之事道歉，二是另外将一些事情告知于你。

9001159.en: Goumang is the deity of Wood, and also was once the master of the Divine Mulberry. He foresaw the destiny and knew something serious was going to befall Chi You. So he withdrew his Wood Qi that supported the Divine Mulberry and went to Chi You to plant the giant tree in Tree Vault.
9001159.ch: 句芒为上界木仙，亦是扶桑树之主，他参透天机，知道赤幽州将有大事发生，于是收回自己维持扶桑树的木灵，在赤幽州另种建木巨树，用来遏制冥气。

9001160.en: Every time Xingtian waved his axe, Nether Air would surge in Chi You. Goumang spared no pains to build the giant Tree Vault to resist the Nether Air over several years, but only could mitigate its spreading.
9001160.ch: 刑天每次挥动战斧，赤幽州便会爆发一次冥气，句芒竭尽全力，以数年间养成的巨树建木抵御冥气，也仅能减缓冥气地扩散。

9001161.en: When he left, he entrusted the Divine Mulberry to my care. And then something happened between you and me. During this period, Goumang continued to infuse Wood Qi to strengthen the Tree Vault, but he was gradually eroded by Nether Air himself.
9001161.ch: 当年他离开扶桑树后，便交由我照看，才有了当初你我之事。在这期间，句芒依旧不断的输入木灵加强建木，但自身也渐渐被冥气侵蚀……

9001162.en: Sensing the crisis of Goumang, I rushed to Chi You to help him; but there was no way to reverse the situation, and even I myself got stuck.
9001162.ch: 我感受到句芒的危险，便也赶到赤幽州来帮他，奈何，也没有办法逆转情形，甚至我自己也陷入进来。

9001163.en: You and I both know that only by killing Xingtian can this crisis be solved. Although I'm weak now, I can still help you, even if at a great cost... As long as Goumang could suffer from the erosion of Nether Air no more...
9001163.ch: 你我都知，击杀刑天才可能解决这次冥气之难，虽然我也陷入了虚弱，但依旧可以助你一臂之力，哪怕要付出巨大的代价……只要句芒能够不再受这冥气侵蚀之苦……

9001164.en: Goumang is a Muzheng, and I am his aide spirit. The rest... is irrelevant... Please think over what I've told you. Come back to me here after you've made up your mind. Please don't tell Goumang about it.
9001164.ch: 句芒是木正，我是他的佐灵，其余……其余都无关紧要了……你好好考虑，若想好了便来找我，请不要告知句芒。

9001165.en: Now that you are here, why not come to have a chat with me in the Tree Vault?
9001165.ch: 盟主既来，何不到建木与我一叙？

9001166.en: I can perceive everything, no matter how trivial, that should happen within the Tree Vault. She's so naive to think she can pull the wool over my eyes...
9001166.ch: 建木范围内，一切风吹草动，我都能感知，碧泓却以为做这些小动作就能瞒过我去，真傻……

9001167.en: Xiang Lingjun once invited me to attack Xingtian with him; but he escaped from the battlefield, resulting in serious injuries to me.
9001167.ch: 当年向令钧邀请我一同攻打刑天，最后却临阵脱逃，导致我身受重伤。

9001168.en: I was very disappointed, and since then it was left to me alone to fight Nether Air. Now I trust no one else but you. As I'm getting weaker by the day, I must defeat Xingtian, or there will never be another chance.
9001168.ch: 此事叫我对人族彻底失望，从此我便独自对抗冥气。现在只有你，我还能相信，眼前我已经逐渐虚弱，若再不击败刑天，恐怕再无机会。

9001169.en: A tree that has lived out its span will wither, and this focus will dissipate completely after I use up my Wood Qi.
9001169.ch: 树的生机尽了，便会枯萎，我的木灵尽了，这抹神识也会彻底消散。

9001170.en: However, if we can defeat Xingtian, we could save the world, and Bihong's life as well. It's worth it...
9001170.ch: 不过若能击败刑天，既解救了八荒，也保全了碧泓的性命，也值得了……

9001171.en: And I can tell you are different from Xiang Lingjun. You will not shun the battle with Xingtian... So I hope you'll take your time to think it through. I'll be waiting for your reply in Tree Vault.
9001171.ch: 我看得出来，你与向令钧不同，定会不避艰险击败刑天……因此希望你好好考虑一下，本座在建木等你的结果。

9001172.en: Goumang wants to help you with his remaining Wood Qi to stop the spread of Nether Air. He is waiting for your reply before activating your potential to help you into the Transcendent Realm.
9001172.ch: 句芒为了阻止冥气扩散，情愿以残余的木灵助你成功，他希望得到你的答复，然后激活你体内潜能，使你成功进入登仙之境。

9001173.en: Goumang intends to save the world at the expense of his own life. He shouldn't... This world will survive and prosper only when he survives.
9001173.ch: 句芒愿意牺牲自己成全八荒世界的延续，他不该……只要他一直活着，相信八荒世界才能一路走好。

9001174.en: Okay. Since you haven't quite grasped the relationship between Nether Air and Energy, I'll fight with you to help you comprehend it and activate your Fire Nether Essence. Are you ready?
9001174.ch: 好。你目前尚未能够好好体会冥气与灵力的关系，我会与你一战尽力激发你参悟这两者关键，并以激发你的火之冥源。你可已准备好了？

9001175.en: After the battle, Bihong's body suddenly burns into a fire and ends up in ashes.
9001175.ch: 碧泓与你一战之后，身体突然无火自燃，最后化为灰烬。

9001176.en: Bihong... Master, you have cleared the nodes within you. Please break through your realm to further strengthen yourself so that you will be capable of fighting Xingtian.
9001176.ch: 碧泓……盟主，眼下你已打通体内关窍，请你进一步突破境界提升实力，如此一来相信便能与刑天一搏。

9001177.en: It's Bihong that saved me and helped you. I have been corrupted by Nether Air irreversibly, and I won't be helpful should anything else happen. But I won't complain. Now I have enough time to be at Bihong's side...
9001177.ch: 多亏碧泓成全了我，成全了你。我身体被冥气侵蚀，已是强弩之末，再有要事我也已无能为力。不过这也不错，一直以来我没时间陪着碧泓，今后就有许多时间了……

9001178.en: Disheartened, Goumang waves his hand to summon a sack that takes in the scattered ashes of Bihong's body, and then puts it away. After standing for a while, his body transforms into wood, which grows into a giant tree...
9001178.ch: 句芒看起来万念俱灰，他手一招，一只锦囊飞出囊括住漫天的碧泓灰烬。他将之好生藏好。然后只站了一会，身体就逐渐化为木头，渐渐长成参天大树……

9001179.en: Goumang... He persuaded you in the end...
9001179.ch: 句芒……句芒终究说服了你……

9001180.en: After I become ashes, Bihong will inherit my role to help you. Don't worry.
9001180.ch: 我化为灰烬之后，碧泓会继承我的志向继续助你，请你不必担心。

9001182.en: After the battle, Goumang's body burns into fire and transforms into a fireball that scatters into ashes...
9001182.ch: 句芒与你一战之后，身体突然燃烧起来，逐渐化为火球，片刻间化为漫天灰烬……

9001183.en: Goumang, is it really worth it? My friend, Goumang has cleared the nodes within you. You should now be able to go deep inside Chi You, and I'm sure you will defeat Xingtian in the end.
9001183.ch: 句芒，你做这一切真的值得么？朋友，句芒已替你打通关窍，你应可以顺利深入赤幽州，相信此后与刑天一搏也定能奏凯。

9001184.en: Ha... Goumang and I were always apart from each other, but I knew he was there, and that was something that supported me... Now that he has gone, there's no point for me to stay here alone...
9001184.ch: 呵……我与句芒聚少离多，但往日他在，我总有个盼头……现今他去了，我独自留下也没什么意味……

9001185.en: With that said, Bihong's body also burns into fire and ends up ashes scattered in the air...
9001185.ch: 碧泓说完全身猛地燃烧起来，片刻化为漫天飞灰……

9001187.en: I hope you will make the right decision to save Bihong from destruction...
9001187.ch: 希望你万万不要想左了以致害了碧泓……

9001190.en: Both of you sacrificed a lot for this world. We are all in your debt. Now, leave the rest to me, and you two should just stay here and watch me rout Xingtian.
9001190.ch: 你们两位为八荒牺牲良多，叫人佩服。接下来的事情便等我处理好了，两位请稳坐建木之侧看我大破刑天。

9001191.en: Master, I... I hope you have thought it through... Xingtian's power is overwhelming without parallel. You wouldn't have even the slightest chance if I hadn't helped you make the realm breakthrough...
9001191.ch: 盟主，你……你可要想明白了……刑天之强，实是匪夷所思，若非我替你突破境界，你可是全无胜机……

9001192.en: Goumang may have his faith in you, but it's too difficult for you alone...
9001192.ch: 句芒对你寄以厚望，凭你个人，无论如何都……

9001193.en: Xingtian may be strong, but it doesn't mean I don't have any chance. I have the entire Cultivator Alliance at my back, and so many disciples have sacrificed themselves in repelling the Wave of Monsters. If I can't bring Xingtian down, there will always be another hero from the alliance to accomplish it.
9001193.ch: 刑天虽强，却非全无胜机。我身后有仙盟支持，仙盟之中又有无数弟子前仆后继，为驱逐妖兽抵挡兽潮，击败刑天而努力。若我不敌刑天，以后仙盟之中亦必有英才横空出世平定此事。

9001194.en: There is only one Xingtian, but there are endless disciples in our Cultivator Alliance. He will be defeated by us eventually.
9001194.ch: 刑天只有一个，而我仙盟弟子后继不断，此消彼长，早晚会为我仙盟击败。

9001195.en: Besides, cultivation is a long journey, and introspection is what matters. Relying on the help of others won't take you far. I must find my own path, achieve breakthroughs, and defeat the archenemy.
9001195.ch: 再者，修仙路远，重在视自省。寄望旁人协助，终究难以成就事业。我必能找到属于自己的“仙道”，成功突破，挫败强敌。

9001196.en: Goumang holds Bihong's hand in his as they smile at each other.
9001196.ch: 句芒牵过碧泓之手，二人相视一笑。

9001198.en: That's what I want to say.

9001199.en: With your spirit and mind, I'm sure you will achieve great accomplishments. Bihong and I underestimated you...
9001199.ch: 盟主心胸气度如此恢弘，想必来日定能成就大事，倒是我与碧泓多事了……

9001200.en: In fact, Goumang and I have been eroded by Nether Air irreversibly over the years...
9001200.ch: 事实上，我与句芒长年受冥气侵蚀，也早已对此事无能为力了……

9001201.en: I have depleted my Wood Qi and will fall into chaos early. I hope one day I will recover my Energy and awaken again. It's only Bihong who will suffer...
9001201.ch: 我木灵殆尽，便提早进入混沌状态，希望有朝一日恢复灵力，重新觉醒。只委屈了碧泓……

9001202.en: How? I will use my Wood Qi to help you recover your energy, and I will have plenty of spare time to rest. I'm looking forward to an easy-going life.
9001202.ch: 岂会委屈？今后我便以木灵助你恢复灵力，我会有大把的时间好好休息，正是无事一身轻的好日子呢。

9001203.en: Master, I hope I will one day awaken to find the once wretched Chi You transformed into a land of peace and prosperity. We hope you will achieve what you have been working for.
9001203.ch: 盟主，盼望我重新觉醒之时，形同鬼域的赤幽州会变成一方乐土。句芒与碧泓只能于此预向盟主成就大事了。

9001204.en: With that said, Goumang transforms into a giant tree, and Bihong follows suit with a smile. Branches sprout from their roots and intertwine with each other. The two trees lean on each other and give off gusts of Qi, sending comfort up your veins.
9001204.ch: 句芒说完慢慢化为大树，碧泓见状亦微微一笑将自己肉身转为树木。他们二人变成树木之后，树根处伸出枝丫，互相勾连，结为连理之枝；两棵大树依傍一起，亲密无间，散发出阵阵灵气，让你百脉流畅，无比舒适。

9001205.en: Goumang and Bihong are waiting near the Tree Vault... What should I do?
9001205.ch: 句芒于碧泓已在建木附近等待……我应该怎么选？

9001206.en: Hope you can kill Xingtian soon.
9001206.ch: 希望你能早日击杀刑天。

9001207.en: But you're a lucky one to win my recognition, and maybe you will turn out promising in the end... Well, I'll tell you more about this. Listen carefully.
9001207.ch: 不过，能得到本座的认可，也算你福泽深厚，说不定真有一丝机缘可窥大道……也罢，我便将此间机要尽皆告知于你，小友可务必听仔细了。

9001208.en: To rise to Transcendent Realm is to overturn the universe and transcend the law of nature to dominate the Heavenly Path!
9001208.ch: 登仙，便是扭转乾坤，超脱八荒山海法则之上，在一方天地内主宰天道！

9001209.en: Exactly! As you know, it is the law of nature in this world for Qi and Nether Air to repel each other. Humans are born with Qi, but inhaling Nether Air will result in death. It is the result of the antagonism between Qi and Nether Air.
9001209.ch: 正是如此！众所周知，八荒之内灵气冥气二者水火不容，此乃自然之理。人类血肉生而有灵，但若吸入冥气便会身死，究其根源在于灵冥二气性质的绝对相反。

9001210.en: After Nether Air enters a human body, it will collide with Qi and cause annihilation, releasing huge energy to blast the visceral organs into pieces...
9001210.ch: 冥气进入人体，与灵气碰撞湮灭，释放出巨大的能量，从而将五脏六腑摧折殆尽……

9001211.en: To rise to the Transcendent Realm is to reverse this law and blend Qi and Nether Air in your body until they co-exist in harmony and transform into Heavenly Power!
9001211.ch: 而登仙，便是要在体内彻底改变此等法则，让灵冥二气彼此交融、阴阳相生，最终成就仙力！

9001212.en: It is a great challenge to rise to the Transcendent Realm. To gather enough Heavenly Power is no easy task, not to mention the trial of lightning after breaking the Heavenly Shell.
9001212.ch: 登仙之途满是险阻，集合三分仙力已属不易。更勿论凭借仙力打通仙壳后，还会天降轰雷？

9001213.en: ...This world will not easily allow anyone to subvert its laws, so it will summon lightning bolts to kill anyone who attempts Transcendent.
9001213.ch: ……八荒山海不会轻易容许违背其规则的存在诞生，故会降下天道雷劫来抹杀试图登仙之人。

9001214.en: It's an arduous journey in front of you, and I'm afraid I won't be able to help you more. But this should be helpful to you on your path to the Transcendent Realm. Please take it.
9001214.ch: 盟主任重而道远，只可惜本座已无余力协助盟主了。不过此物或能成您登仙途中的助力。请收下。

9001215.en: You are here? Time is limited, and when you fight with full ability, I will examine the nodes inside you and the direction your Energy is flowing to. Then I will find a chance to thrust the Wood Qi into you so that you won't fear Nether Air in the depths of Chi You. Are you ready?
9001215.ch: 来了？时间不多，你先用尽全力和我一战，我会在你出手之际，洞察你体内关窍及灵力走向，借机将木蕴仙元打入你体内，方可不惧赤幽州深处的冥气，你可已经准备好了？

9001216.en: I will also take my full ability into the battle, thus it will be tough. Please be careful.
9001216.ch: 本座此次会全力出手，此战定必十分凶险，你一定要倍加小心。

9001217.en: Bihong is not involved in it. Don't worry about her.
9001217.ch: 碧泓与此事无关，你不必惦记。

9001218.en: Suddenly, after a long and harsh battle, Goumang coughs fiercely.
9001218.ch: 句芒与你激斗良久后，突然剧烈咳嗽。

9001219.en: I condensed a breath of Wood Spirit into the Wood Qi and infused it into your body. Now the hinterland of Chi You is open to the Transcendent Realm...
9001219.ch: 如今我已将一口木灵聚成“木蕴仙元”度入你体内，登仙之境便可自由出入赤幽州深处……

9001220.en: Master, I'll rest for a while. Then, let us begin our journey to slay Xingtian!
9001220.ch: 盟主，待我稍微休息，这便一同去击杀刑天吧！

9001223.en: Now you can't constrain anyone, even me. How could you fight against Xingtian?
9001223.ch: 你现在连我都困不住了，怎么对付得了刑天？

9001224.en: It's none of your business, Bihong. Please, go back.
9001224.ch: 此处没有你的事，碧泓，回去吧……

9001225.en: Bihong gestures with a hand, and vines emerge from the soil beneath Goumang. Seeing himself is bound by those vines, Goumang shakes his torso slightly, and the verdant tendrils wither into ashes. Gnashing her teeth, Bihong gestures again, and this time a glowing green vine catches Goumang.
9001225.ch: 碧泓挥手一划，地上长出藤蔓将句芒束缚住，句芒上身微摆，捆身藤曼瞬间化为灰烬，碧泓一咬牙，挥手放出一条泛着绿光的青藤再次缠住句芒。

9001226.en: Seeing the vine, Goumang is astonished.
9001226.ch: 句芒盯着青藤，瞬间神色大变。

9001227.en: It is... condensed from your Wood Spirit? Why should you do this?
9001227.ch: 这是……以你木灵结成的青藤？这是何苦？

9001228.en: Goumang, I shall not see you die so futilely!
9001228.ch: 句芒，我绝不会眼睁睁的看着你去送死的！

9001229.en: And you? Isn't it futile too, if you die here?
9001229.ch: 难道我就能眼睁睁看着你送死么？

9001231.en: Bihong condenses a green vine with her Wood Spirit to bind Goumang, but Goumang is not willing to escape from its grasp by destroying the Spirit. The two are trapped in a stalemate...
9001231.ch: 碧泓以自身结成青藤困住句芒，然而句芒不忍损毁碧泓木灵。二人已成僵持之局……

9001232.en: Goumang, your ability is restricted by the Power of Law after you came here, and besides, your physique is much weaker than before for fighting the Nether Air for a long time.
9001232.ch: 句芒，你来到八荒受规则之力限制，又长期对抗冥气，你的实力已远不如从前了。

9001233.en: Because of this, you are always seeking help from the Alliance, aren't you? Maybe this is the one you're looking for?
9001233.ch: 你当初也在寻求仙盟的帮助，不是么？也许，也许这便是你一直寻找的人呢？

9001235.en: Please, persuade him. I know he believes, and will believe, you.
9001235.ch: 求求你，说服句芒。我知道的他心底是相信你的。

9001238.en: Goumang, everyone needs help, including you.
9001238.ch: 句芒，任谁都需要别人帮助，你也不例外。

9001240.en: You think you could defeat Xingtian with the help of what?
9001240.ch: 你以为自己凭什么能够打败刑天？

9001241.en: I have the support of the Cultivator Alliance, as well as my companions. They can help me when I'm in need.
9001241.ch: 我有仙盟，有同伴，他们会协助我度过难关。

9001242.en: I come here from Bai Yuan. Hardships along this way have all been conquered by me, and I believe I could once more challenge the impossible—I'll slay Xingtian!
9001242.ch: 由白源来到此处，无数困难都被我克服。我定能再次突破极限，斩杀刑天！

9001243.en: Where there is a will, there is a way.

9001244.en: Goumang, please, trust this one before you. The Master can help you, and can also help us!
9001244.ch: 句芒，试着相信眼前之人好么？盟主能帮你，能帮我们！

9001246.en: The power of Xingtian is overwhelming and unimaginable. Do you know it?
9001246.ch: 刑天实力之强，匪夷所思，你可想明白了？

9001249.en: I know I'm so weak now. Even if I want to join you, it would be too demanding for me to perform. Master, please, do your best.
9001249.ch: 我的状态已经很差了，就是想出力，也已十分勉强。盟主，便请你尽力吧。

9001250.en: It's too consuming for me to exist as a human in this world. Thus, I'll transform back into my true form, and begin to hibernate. One day if my Energy is fully restored, I will wake again.
9001250.ch: 在八荒山海维持人身损耗太大，我会回归真形，暂时休眠，以期有朝一日，恢复灵力，重新觉醒。

9001252.en: Goumang looks at Bihong with a gentle smile on his face for the first time, and then reaches out to hold her hand.
9001252.ch: 句芒注视碧泓，脸上首次露出温柔的笑意，然后伸过手去牵住碧泓。

9001254.en: Master, please carry your plan out, and see it done.
9001254.ch: 接下来的一切就交给你了，盟主。

9001257.en: Time is limited, are you ready?
9001257.ch: 时间不多，你可准备好了？

9001258.en: You come to the place agreed with Bihong, but can't find anyone here.
9001258.ch: 你来到与碧泓约定之处，但此地空空如也，并无人踪。

9001259.en: You follow the direction of the Alliance and find a sunflower shining like fire...
9001259.ch: 你依仙盟指示在一处死地找到一朵闪耀焰光的葵花……

9001260.en: You try to pick it, and it is so hot that it burns your hand. The Alliance apothecary waiting for you finds you are wounded and give you some elixirs to heal the wound.
9001260.ch: 你伸手将之摘掉，不料异花炽热非常，竟将你烫伤。仙盟药司等候接洽，他见你受伤，即送上药丸数枚给你疗伤。

9001261.en: You arrive at a deep cave and find a sunflower shining like fire. You pick it up and give it to the Alliance apothecary waiting for you.
9001261.ch: 你来到一处深穴之中，果然看见一朵亮着焰光的葵花。你将之摘掉之后转交等候接洽的仙盟药司。

9001262.en: You arrive on top of a cliff and run into a monster. It notices you and pounces on you.
9001262.ch: 你来到一处绝壁之上，不料一只妖兽徘徊其间。此妖看你接近，竟不顾一切朝你猛扑而来。

9001263.en: You defeat the monster, pick the fire sunflower, and wait for the apothecary to take it. He knows you must have fought a fierce battle to obtain it, so he gives you a Spiritual Item in return.
9001263.ch: 你将妖兽击败后立即摘走焰葵，等候接洽的药司将药草收走。他知道你为取此花，已恶战一场，故赠你灵物一枚。

9001264.en: You swallow the lead and feel a surge of hot stream in you that cleanses your inside and ejects all the filth.
9001264.ch: 你将丹铅服下，感觉此物瞬间化为滚滚热流，荡涤全身，将体内污浊洗刷一空。

9001265.en: A girl is looking into the distance while wiping her forehead. It is Feng Lixi.
9001265.ch: 一名少女正手抹额头，遥望远方。那是风里希。

9001266.en: Oh, it's you. The Flame Begonia behind the Alliance territory is very rare. You must be here to forage it too?
9001266.ch: 是你啊。仙盟后方的焰芯冰葵奇特罕有，你也是来这里采药的吧？

9001267.en: So you are here to gather Flame Begonia for Cultivator Alliance? I have gathered quite a lot. I can give some to you if you like.
9001267.ch: 你来到这边，是为仙盟采集焰芯冰葵吧？我这里已经采了很多，若不介意，我分你一些吧。

9001268.en: Feng Lixi gives you some begonias and walks on. She seems to be looking for something.
9001268.ch: 风里希将冰葵交给你后，又继续前行。她似乎正在找什么。

9001269.en: Feng Lixi has sprained her ankle and is sitting at the side of the road. It must be painful.
9001269.ch: 风里希扭伤了脚，正蹲坐路边，她看起来十分难受。

9001270.en: I wanted to gather the herb up there, but I missed my step and fell. I'm so stupid. Only if I had studied more carefully from father and Pingmo. Could you...gather that herb up there for me?
9001270.ch: 我想采上面的药材，结果摔下来了。我真笨，都怪以前没有好好跟父亲和风萍末姐姐学习。你……你能帮我去摘一下那个药材吗？

9001271.en: You climb up and reach the Flame Begonia Feng Lixi wants. It's a little different from the other begonias. You pick it up and give it to her.
9001271.ch: 你前往高处，发现风里希想要采摘的那也是一朵焰心冰葵。你将之摘下交给她。

9001272.en: Thank you... It's one more I have.
9001272.ch: 谢谢……这么一来又找到一株了。

9001273.en: You wasted a lot of time on me. Please take some of my Flame Begonias. Thank you!
9001273.ch: 你帮我采药草已经耽误不少时间，我把我身上的焰芯冰葵分你吧。多谢你！

9001274.en: Lixi should have gone...this way... Or not?
9001274.ch: 里希……应该从这边去了……到底是不是呢？

9001275.en: Hero, have you...met Lady Lixi? She has been away for three days. Chief Feng is busy with the Alliance affairs. He will be worried if he finds out Lixi has disappeared.
9001275.ch: 恩人，你……你有看见里希少主么？她离开营地已有三天了，风族长为仙盟之事奔波，若发现里希不见了一定十分担心。

9001277.en: You take Feng Pingmo to the place where Feng Lixi was foraging the other day. A shriek is heard in the distance. It is Feng Lixi, and she is being held by a monster!
9001277.ch: 你将风萍末带到日前风里希采药的地方。就在此时附近传来尖叫声。而你发现了风里希踪迹，她被一只妖兽抓住！

9001278.en: Astonished, Feng Pingmo takes out her sword, kills the monster, and saves Feng Lixi.
9001278.ch: 风萍末大惊失色，忙拔刀斩杀妖兽，救下风里希。

9001279.en: Lixi, you should not get too far away from the camp. Though it's behind the Alliance territory, there are still some monsters lurking here...
9001279.ch: 里希，你不该离开营地这么远的。虽然这里是仙盟后方，但仍有妖兽潜藏……

9001280.en: But... Pingmo, look. I found it. An Icy Begonia with two cores!
9001280.ch: 可是……末姐姐，你看。我找到了。双芯冰葵！

9001281.en: You meant well, but Chief will be worried if he finds out you have disappeared. Let's go back to the camp.
9001281.ch: 你虽是一片好意，但让族长发现你不见了，定会十分担心，我们这便回去吧。

9001283.en: Thank you for coming with Pingmo to save me... I have gathered a lot of Flame Begonias. Please take some of them! We're going back to the camp.
9001283.ch: 多谢你陪末姐姐来救我……别的没有，这些焰芯冰葵我采了不少，便分你一些吧！我们先回去了。

9001284.en: Many Alliance disciples were assaulted by monsters lately. I suppose the Alliance will send someone to forage here? Oh! Someone is coming! Excuse me!
9001284.ch: 仙盟近日遭遇妖兽袭击伤亡颇多，应该会遣人来这采药吧？啊！果然来了！能麻烦你一下么？

9001285.en: *sigh* I left the camp without permission to forage the other day, and Pingmo went after me to take me back. But father was furious about Pingmo leaving her post and locked her up!
9001285.ch: 唉……日前我私自出来采药，数日不归，末姐姐因为担心，所以离开营地找我。没想到父亲大发雷霆，怪责末姐姐擅离职守，竟将她关了起来！

9001286.en: I wanted to explain to father, but he was too busy with Alliance affairs. Could you...help me intercede with him? It was my fault that Pingmo was...
9001286.ch: 我想跟父亲解释，可他转过头又忙活仙盟的事情了。你……你能替我去为末姐姐说情么？都是因为我……才会……

9001287.en: Hero, it's such an honor! Please take a seat!
9001287.ch: 恩人光临我族，风某倍感欣喜，请稍坐休息！

9001288.en: *sigh* I thought Pingmo had left her post without permission. That's why I lost my temper and locked her up. I knew I was wrong and I set her free. I have been troubled by Alliance affairs lately.
9001288.ch: 唉……当时我以为风萍末擅离职守，竟然怒火勃发，将她关了起来。后来我也知道不对，已将她放了。近日仙盟之事总叫我十分烦恼。

9001289.en: There are still some matters waiting for my decision. Please excuse me. Take your time to walk around our camp. Our people will be happy to meet you.
9001289.ch: 风某还有几件琐事要处理，恕我失陪。若无要事，请随意在营地逛逛，族中之人定会很高兴你能前来相聚。

9001290.en: I have heard about it. You are here to intercede for me... Thank you.
9001290.ch: 我听说了，你是特意来为我说情的……谢谢。

9001291.en: Chief Feng came to Chi You to learn more about the Nether Air and help our people get rid of the suffering it caused. He thought everything would be solved after defeating Xingtian.
9001291.ch: 风族长来到赤幽州，乃是为了进一步了解冥气，好设法为族人摆脱冥气之患。原本他以为只要击倒刑天，有关冥气一切就能迎刃而解。

9001292.en: However, as he learned more about the Nether Air, he felt it was not Xingtian who activated the Nether Air, but the Nether Air that affected Xingtian... As long as the Nether Air remains, Chi You and the Wave of Monsters will remain unchanged... (prepare for subsequent gameplay of Wave of Monsters)
9001292.ch: 可族长近日发现事情没有那么简单。他觉得，不是刑天带动冥气，反而是冥气影响了刑天……只要冥气还存在，赤幽州、兽潮，还会保持现状……(为兽潮后续玩法铺垫）

9001293.en: That's why Chief Feng is troubled and anxious lately.
9001293.ch: 风族长为此烦恼，所以近日才会屡屡焦躁。

9001294.en: Chief Feng left to fight the monsters the other day and was heavily wounded. But before his wound was fully healed, he had returned to handle tribe affairs and help the Alliance deal with the Wave of Monsters.
9001294.ch: 风族长近日曾外出抵御妖兽，他于激战中受了重伤。但族长不等伤势痊愈又即处置族中事务，还协助仙盟对付兽潮。

9001295.en: Lixi was worried about Chief's health, so she sneaked out to forage to make an elixir. It requires a two-cored Flame Begonia as a material that only grows in high places. So it took her a lot of time to search and forage out there.
9001295.ch: 里希担心族长，便外出采药配一味续元冷霜，给族长治愈伤势。冷霜所需双焰芯冰葵十分稀有，多长在高处。她冒险采药，因此滞留在外。

9001296.en: You helped her twice. Thank you so much.
9001296.ch: 风萍末得你两次照顾，感激不尽。

9001297.en: Thank you for interceding for Pingmo... I also gathered some other herbs. I believe the Alliance needs them too these days.
9001297.ch: 多谢你替末姐姐说情……我为了采双芯冰葵，得了一些别的珍贵药草。都是仙盟近日急需的。

9001298.en: And this is an elixir made with the remaining two-cored Flame Begonias. It can clear your veins and improve your Vitality. I hope they will be useful to you. (exhausted)
9001298.ch: 还有，这个是用剩余双芯冰葵配制的丹药，能舒通气脉，增长体力。这些希望你都不要嫌弃。咳咳……（累）

9001299.en: Feng Lixi takes you to her father Feng Yunchuo, who seems to be troubled in contemplation...
9001299.ch: 风里希带你找到她的父亲风允婼，其时他似乎正在沉思，正为某事犯愁的样子……

9001301.en: You take the elixir and feel a warm stream of air gushing out from under your feet up to your head. In the meantime, you feel a cold stream of air moving down to your heels. The two streams meet in your belly and blend together, sending comfort all over your body...
9001301.ch: 你吞服此药后，脚底涌出暖流，直贯顶门；同时脑际百会之穴又生出寒流猛往双踵急冲。寒热二气最终在丹田交汇，融成一团，你瞬间感觉遍体舒畅……

9001302.en: You infuse Energy into the defensive spells on the wall, and the broken wall surface gradually recovers.
9001302.ch: 你为城墙上的防守禁咒注入灵力，城墙上断裂的禁咒界壁因此渐渐恢复。

9001303.en: You arrive at the wall and find several monsters gnawing and clawing at the spells.
9001303.ch: 你来到城墙边上的时候，竟发现有几只妖物在破坏城墙禁咒枢纽。

9001304.en: Who could have thought these monsters should appear behind the wall all of a sudden? If you hadn't been there to kill them, the defensive spells would have been destroyed. Uh, they have sensed it, haven't they?
9001304.ch: 没想到这几只妖物竟突然出现在城墙之内，若非道友出手将妖物击杀，恐怕禁咒要毁于一旦。唔，难道它们应该已经察觉到了……

9001305.en: I'm Elder's bodyguard Xi Zhao. Could you please do me a favor?
9001305.ch: 在下长老近卫奚照。恕我冒昧，你能帮我一个忙么？

9001306.en: This underground area is the nexus of the spells on the wall. If you can nurture it with your Energy, it will be very beneficial to the repair work of the wall.
9001306.ch: 此处地下乃是城墙禁咒枢纽，若得灵力滋润，于仙盟城墙修复大有好处。

9001307.en: You do as Xi Zhao said and infuse Energy into the ground, and the cracks on the wall gradually disappear.
9001307.ch: 你依奚照之言对地上输入灵力，城墙上各处裂纹果然都渐渐弥合。

9001308.en: Thank you so much. Most of the spells on the wall have been repaired. Elder Luo chose you for a good reason. Here are two elixirs for you. Hope they will restore your lost Energy.
9001308.ch: 感激。城墙上的禁咒也已恢复得七七八八。骆长老果然没看错人。奚照这里有两枚药丸，可以聊补阁下损失灵力。

9001309.en: You are here to repair the spells where cracks appear on the wall? Could you please do me a favor?
9001309.ch: 道友眼看城墙禁咒出现裂缝，是故过来修复么？若道友不介意，能否请你帮我一个忙？

9001310.en: You follow Xi Zhao into a cave with countless holes and feel a strange power that is drawing some Energy out of your body. Suddenly, rocks and earth appear in the cave and fill the holes.
9001310.ch: 跟随奚照进入一个千疮百孔的洞穴后，你感觉一股奇怪的力量将你体内灵力吸去一部分。之后，内洞突然自己生出岩石泥土填补各处空缺。

9001311.en: Thank you. It's done now. Here are some elixirs for you. Please excuse me.
9001311.ch: 谢谢道友。这样便好。这里几枚丹药便送给道友吧。奚照还有事，先告辞了。

9001312.en: My friend, could you do me another favor?
9001312.ch: 道友，奚照还想麻烦你随我走一趟，如何？

9001313.en: You walk into a giant cave with countless holes and feel a formless power that is drawing Energy and Vitality out of your body.
9001313.ch: 你进入一个充满孔窍的巨大洞穴，并再次感到一股无形之力吸取你的灵力体力。

9001314.en: Don't panic! It'll be over soon.

9001315.en: I'm afraid you have lost quite a lot of Energy this time. These elixirs are the only compensations I can offer.
9001315.ch: 此回道友体内灵力受损颇为严重。只可惜奚照身无长物，也只能聊赠数枚丹药给你稍为恢复一下。

9001316.en: I have some other affairs to tend to. Please excuse me.
9001316.ch: 奚照还有几件琐事，这便失陪了。

9001317.en: *cough* Could you please come with me... *cough*
9001317.ch: 咳咳……咳……可否请您，随我来一趟……咳咳……

9001318.en: You follow Xi Zhao into a hidden path leading underground. You hear some noise behind you and turn your head, but Xi Zhao is nowhere to be found. It is dark in the direction where you came, and it is different than before...
9001318.ch: 奚照将你带到一处通往地底的暗道，你感觉背后发出一些动静，回头看去，奚照已经不见了。而后方黑漆漆的已不复来时情景……

9001319.en: It's dark ahead, illuminated by only one light blue flame every one hundred steps. It's the same behind you.
9001319.ch: 此时前方昏暗，大约每隔百步有幽蓝火焰照亮道路；回顾后方，也是一般情形。

9001320.en: You walk for a long time before you find yourself in front of a small temple. All its doors and windows are open, and there is a strange lump of soil on the stone pedestal inside.
9001320.ch: 你也不知道在廊道里走了多久，前方突然出现一座小殿。殿阁门户打开，只见里面石座上放着一块奇特的泥壤……

9001321.en: Suddenly, a cold wind blows behind you, and you hear messed footsteps coming near...
9001321.ch: 正当此时，你背后吹来阴风一阵，不规律的踢踏脚步声无故响起……

9001323.en: According to Xi Zhao, this is a secret dungeon built by the Alliance over a hundred years. It has a seemingly straight corridor, but it is actually a winding and complex one. In this dungeon is stored a very important artifact of the Alliance.
9001323.ch: 依奚照所言，此处乃是仙盟耗费百年营造的琅嬛地宫。联通的廊道看似是一条直路，实则曲折环绕，错综复杂。而仙盟在此处放置一件极为重要的法宝。

9001324.en: I brought you here to repair that artifact... Sorry, I felt unwell just now and passed out. In this dungeon, one step in the wrong direction might take you a hundred leagues away... You are now over a hundred leagues away from the entrance.
9001324.ch: 带你来此，只为修复那件法宝……抱歉，在下因故抱恙以致突然晕厥。地宫之中，错踏半步即可能去到数里之外……此时你已远离入口数百里了。

9001325.en: After I came to myself, I looked for you all over the place. Fortunately you have already arrived here.
9001325.ch: 我醒来后四处找你，不想你竟然自己走到这里来了。

9001327.en: After the first generation of Alliance cultivators arrived in Chi You, they found a Xirang to lift the ground to mountains as a line of defense against the Wave of Monsters. That was how they survived.
9001327.ch: 先辈们初到赤幽州便设法找到一份息壤隆起高山构筑防线，仙盟也因此勉强挡住兽潮冲击，苟存下来。

9001328.en: Caves are everywhere underground in Chi You. They are interconnected and may be used by the monsters to move behind our Alliance territory.
9001328.ch: 赤幽州地底布满各种洞穴，我们以为后方不时出现的妖兽乃是通过地底纵横交错的洞穴来到我们仙盟防线范围内。

9001329.en: Such monsters can be quite a handful, so we used the Xirang to generate earth and rocks to fill the holes of the caves and sever their connection with each other...
9001329.ch: 这些妖兽神出鬼没，让我们防不胜防，故此亦以息壤生出泥岩堵塞地底孔窍……

9001330.en: With more and more Waves of Monsters in recent years, the Energy in the Xirang is almost depleted, so we hope you could restore it.
9001330.ch: 近年兽潮越发汹涌，尽管息壤饱含灵力，也已近透支之境。故此唯有借用道友灵力给息壤休养生息。

9001331.en: Xi Zhao points to the Xirang on the pedestal. This magical artifact seems to have sensed your approach. It lets out a suction that draws Energy out of your body, and within a short time the depleted Xirang is energetic again.
9001331.ch: 奚照指了指石座上的息壤。此枚神奇的法宝感知到你的接近随即发出吸力吸取你体内灵力，片刻之后原本干涸的泥壤逐渐变得滋润。

9001332.en: After repairing the Xirang, Xi Zhao leads you out of the dungeon. The loss of Energy leaves you dizzy.
9001332.ch: 息壤修复之后，奚照带你离开琅嬛地宫。而你被吸去灵力，亦感觉一阵恶心。

9001333.en: Thank you... *cough* This repair work did some harm to your body. This is a Jade Incense I completed lately... Its fragrance can help your body recover... And please take these elixirs too to recover more quickly...
9001333.ch: 感激……咳咳……此次修复息壤对您身体颇有损伤，因此奚照近日已制成玉澄仙香一支……闻香之后或能祛除您身体异状……另有丹丸数枚，也给您调理身体……

9001334.en: *cough* Elder Luo entrusted me with the task of attending to the Xirang and maintaining the wall spells. I have finally completed the task... *cough*
9001334.ch: 咳咳！奚照得骆长老信任专职照管息壤维护城墙禁咒，现在总算可以有一个交代了……咳咳！

9001335.en: You inhale the fragrance and feel Qi revolving smoothly within you, sending overflowing Energy all over your skin.
9001335.ch: 你吸入此香之后，体内气机流转，百脉和顺，遍体生出灵力。

9001337.en: You follow the direction of an Alliance cultivator and arrive at a hidden cave after taking a rough path, where you find the scroll you are looking for.
9001337.ch: 你依仙盟之人指点，经历崎岖来到一个隐秘洞府之中。而你果然在里面找到一份书简。

9001338.en: You follow the direction of an Alliance cultivator and arrive at a hidden cave after taking a rough path, where you find the scroll you are looking for. Just as you are about to take it, a sinister wind blows and transforms into a shadow to attack you.
9001338.ch: 你依仙盟之人指点，经历崎岖来到一个隐秘洞府之中。而你果然在里面找到一份书简。但就在你取走书简之际，洞中阴风猛作，须臾聚成人影朝你袭来。

9001339.en: You take the ancient scrolls back, and the Alliance immediately sends someone to collect and take care of them.
9001339.ch: 你将古老书简取回，同时仙盟亦立即派出专司之人接洽，将古简妥善收走保管。

9001341.en: Please give this to the Alliance Library Manager.
9001341.ch: 将此物交还仙盟百城殿主事保管吧。

9001342.en: I...am Library Manager Mu Kuiyuan... I'm not good at fighting monsters. Could you please escort me somewhere to retrieve an ancient scroll?
9001342.ch: 我……是百城殿主事沐窥圆……我不善长与妖物战斗，你能陪我去取一本古籍残简么？

9001343.en: Follow me... It's over there... Oh! It's blocked by a seal here. Let's make a detour and enter from the other side to save the trouble.
9001343.ch: 跟我来……在那边……啊！这里面似乎有什么封印，我们从另外一边绕进去。这样一来就不必动手了。

9001344.en: You take the ancient scroll in the cave and hand it over to Mu Kuiyuan.
9001344.ch: 你取得洞府内的古籍，转交沐窥圆。

9001345.en: Oh, I see... Since ancient times, the Lord of Tree Vault southwest of Chi You has been competing with Xingtian. He established many tree arrays around the Tree Vault to stop invaders. Why would the Tree Vault fight Xingtian?
9001345.ch: 啊，原来是这样……很久以前，赤幽州西南角建木之主就和刑天一直暗中角力。建木主人还在建木周围建立大量树阵对付入侵者。建木为什么要和刑天战斗？

9001347.en: It's you again... That's great... Could you come here? You know I'm not good at fighting monsters, so I want you to escort me somewhere to quickly retrieve an old book. It won't take you too much time.
9001347.ch: 又是你啊……太好了……你能过来一下么？你知道的，我一直不善长和妖物战斗。所以希望你能陪我拿一下一本古籍，很快的。

9001348.en: You follow Mu Kuiyuan's direction, retrieve the old book from a mysterious cave, and hand it over to him.
9001348.ch: 你依沐窥圆指点在一处神秘洞府里取得古籍，并将之转交给他。

9001349.en: Oh? It was left behind by a certain Duanmu. Interesting...
9001349.ch: 哦？这是端木家的先辈留下的。有意思……

9001350.en: Duanmu? It's a big clan in the Alliance, and an unorthodox one. They believe monsters are also "cultivators" in a sense since they absorb the Nether Air to cultivate.
9001350.ch: 端木家？端木家是仙盟之中的大族，也是仙盟之中的异端。他们认为妖兽吸取冥气修炼，其实是另外一种“修仙者”。

9001351.en: The Duanmu clan believes monsters are not different than us. Well, if you ask me, I won't say things like that in public, not in such a blunt way...
9001351.ch: 端木家认为妖兽和我们没什么不同。嘿，若是我，便绝不会把这种话挂在嘴边的，至少得换个说法嘛……

9001352.en: They are wise and insightful people, but they don't have much influence now...
9001352.ch: 这一族之人大都颇有真知灼见。只可惜，他们已经式微了……

9001353.en: Sorry, I was lost in thought... Thank you for coming with me... I wouldn't know how to deal with the monsters if I were alone...
9001353.ch: 抱歉，我想得入神了……多谢你陪我……不然要遇见妖兽都不知道该怎么办……

9001354.en: I'm Mu Kuiyuan and I'm too weak to fight the monsters. Since you are working for the Alliance Library, I hope you could retrieve a book in a cave for me. Though...you may encounter a fierce battle there...
9001354.ch: 我是道法肤浅，不善长和妖物战斗的沐窥圆。你既为仙盟百城殿出力，不如直接帮我到洞府里拿本书好了。虽然……可能会遭遇激烈的战斗……

9001356.en: I see... According to the ancient book, the Alliance once had contact with the Lord of Tree Vault southwest of Chi You... Ah. Only the Alliance Master was allowed to go there... I wonder why... What could have happened there...
9001356.ch: 难怪难怪……古籍里面提到，原来很久以前仙盟已经和赤幽州西南角的建木之主有过交往……唔，只有仙盟之主可以前往……这是为什么……到底那边发生什么事……

9001357.en: The Heavenly Shell... The Transcendent Art! Perhaps the key to Transcendent is hidden in the Tree Vault? The blending of Nether Air and Qi... How can it be possible?! The highest law of the world forbids us from Realm Breakthrough... Why?
9001357.ch: 仙壳……是登仙之法！难道建木那边藏着什么登仙的奥秘么？融合冥器和灵气……怎么可能？！八荒的最高规则不允许我们突破境界……这是为什么？

9001358.en: Sorry, I...was lost in thought... No monsters on our way here, huh? Heehee...
9001358.ch: 对不起，我……我想得太入神了……跟着我也不会遇见什么难对付的妖物吧？嘿嘿……

9001359.en: Do you...remember me? I'm Mu Kuiyuan, the Library Manager. Could you escort me somewhere to retrieve an ancient book? I'm too weak to fight the monsters... I need someone to escort me...
9001359.ch: 你……记得我么？我是沐窥圆，百城殿主事。可以陪我取古籍么？我实在打不过穷凶极恶的妖兽……只得四处求人……

9001360.en: This time, you run into monsters when you arrive at the cave where the ancient book is stored. Instead of attacking you, they pounce on the rotten book to rip them...
9001360.ch: 此次你进入洞府寻找古籍竟然遭遇妖兽。这些妖兽不朝你们扑来却去撕洞中半已腐坏的古籍……

9001361.en: Mu Kuiyuan calms down and becomes attentive despite his usual agitation, He casts spells and releases Tao to blast the monsters into ashes by Martial Arts...
9001361.ch: 沐窥圆见状，一改惊慌彷徨神色，变得十分专注。他手拈法诀释放道法，对面的妖兽瞬间被他功法炸为齑粉……

9001362.en: We got here just in time! Ancient books can hardly withstand their destruction.
9001362.ch: 幸好幸好！古籍这种东西最是经不得折腾了。

9001363.en: Oh, this is what I wanted to know! Yes... Another secret of long life? I never knew the Nether Air could prevent the flesh from rotting.
9001363.ch: 啊，我要知道的就是这个了！嗯……这是另外一种长生之法吧？冥气竟如此神奇，可以让肉身不腐。

9001364.en: I see... Some Duanmus are born with immunity to the Nether Air... But why? Will they ever die? Will their bodies remain unrotten after death?
9001364.ch: 嗯……端木家有一些人就是天生不太怕冥气的……他们是为什么会这样？端木家的人会死去么？死去后是不是就肉身不腐了？

9001365.en: Thanks to you, I'm still alive. I have a good memory of knowledge, but a poor one of people. But I will definitely remember you!
9001365.ch: 多谢你，如果不是你，沐窥圆可能早就死于妖兽之手了。书我是过目不忘的，但人却不太记得谁是谁，但我一定会记住你的！

9001367.en: You arrive at the indica rice field and use your Energy to nurture it. The nurtured plants start to sway, as if greeting and thanking you.
9001367.ch: 你来到玉籼区域，以体内灵力滋养仙稻。而面前的大片稻米受到你的灵力滋养，竟纷纷摇曳起来仿佛在跟你招呼道谢。

9001368.en: You arrive at the indica rice field and use your Energy to nurture it. Suddenly, one of the plants grows mature and a full grain of rice with soft luster drops.
9001368.ch: 你来到玉籼区域，以体内灵力滋养玉籼。其中一株玉籼突然抽穗，跌出一粒萦绕柔光的饱满米粒。

9001369.en: You swallow the rice grain and are surprised to find it's as sweet as sugar. It slips down your throat before converting into a warm stream of air to circulate all over your body.
9001369.ch: 你服下玉籼。不想这小小米粒，一经咀嚼竟绽放甘甜水汁。而水汁好像滑溜的水银，嗖的一下落入你的喉咙并随即化为暖和的气流，蔓延全身。

9001370.en: Oh! You are here! Do you want to take a walk to the indica rice fields over there?
9001370.ch: 咦！你怎么来啦？要不要一起到那边玉籼田陌逛逛？

9001371.en: In front of you is a large rice field, and a deeply tanned cultivator is clearing the irrigation channels.
9001371.ch: 前方大片稻田，阳光底下一名浑身黝黑的修仙者正在疏浚田陌间的水道。

9001373.en: What are you up to these days?

9001374.en: Premium Indica Rice. If I can grow it successfully, it will be a great source of Energy and Vitality for the Alliance Guards! I'll do all I can to make it work!
9001374.ch: 是玉籼丙申，如果成功种出来，就能够很好的补充我们仙卫的灵力体力！无论如何我都要尽快将之培植成功！

9001375.en: Wish you luck, Wei He! We'll spread some Energy here!
9001375.ch: 加油喔，老卫！我们在这附近撒一下灵力！

9001376.en: Gu Yuan'er takes you on a walk around the indica rice field. She unleashes and sprays some Energy all over the field, and the plants get nurtured and start to sway.
9001376.ch: 顾鸢儿带着你在这片玉籼田附近逛了逛，她逼出灵力，随手挥洒，田里的水稻得到滋养，纷纷摇曳起来。

9001377.en: We have fertilized Wei He's rice. Let's go!
9001377.ch: 给老卫的稻施过“肥”了。我们走吧！

9001378.en: Oh? You're here to fuel the indica rice with Energy? Let's visit Wei He first. I heard he was ill...
9001378.ch: 啊？你来给玉籼补充灵力么？我们先一起看看老卫吧？他好像病倒了……

9001379.en: You arrive at Wei He's house near the field and find him lying on the bed. He wakes up at your arrival and struggles to sit up, but then lies back down again.
9001379.ch: 你们去到玉籼附近的卫禾住处，他卧在床榻。听到你们进入的动静后，卫禾突然醒转并且挣扎起来，但马上又摔倒在地。

9001380.ch: 老卫，你病了起来干嘛呀？

9001381.en: Premium Indica Rice... Premium Indica Rice... Time to spray Energy...
9001381.ch: 玉籼丙申……玉籼丙申……该用灵力滋养了……

9001382.en: Don't worry! This is a very powerful cultivator. He will spray Energy onto the indica rice to help them grow!
9001382.ch: 你躺着就好了！这位是十分厉害的大能，他来给玉籼撒下灵力，保证玉籼快高长大！

9001384.en: You and Gu Yuan'er return to the indica rice field and start to spray Energy. Seeing this, Wei He heaves a sigh of relief and falls asleep again.
9001384.ch: 你与顾鸢儿前往玉籼布散灵力，滋养玉籼，卫禾看了以后这才舒了口气，慢慢闭上双眼，睡了过去。

9001385.en: *sigh* No wonder Aunt Luo says Wei He is a maniac... Let's go and let him rest.
9001385.ch: 唉，难怪姑姑说老卫是个痴人……我们走吧，别妨碍他休息了。

9001386.en: Eh... Wei He has just turned a little better and he is already working again. What shall I do about him?
9001386.ch: 呃……老卫才好了一丁点又爬起来了。怎么办呢？

9001387.en: *sigh* I asked him to stay home for a few more days, but he just won't listen! He's really a handful!
9001387.ch: 哎呀！我还叮嘱老卫歇几天打打坐，但他就是不听。真气人！

9001388.en: Gu Yuan'er goes up to Wei He's house in a huff, where Wei He is grafting a rice ear with shivering hands. Gu Yuan'er grabs the rice ear from his hand, and returns to the indica rice field to spray Energy to nurture the experiment field of Premium Indica Rice.
9001388.ch: 顾鸢儿说着气冲冲的走到卫禾的住处，当时卫禾正双手颤抖着嫁接一下一株稻穗。顾鸢儿见了一把夺过了稻穗，然后到外面籼田运功以灵力滋养这片实验中的玉籼丙申。

9001389.en: I can't lie in bed all day. I must grow Premium Indica Rice as soon as possible.
9001389.ch: 不能休息的。得尽快种出玉籼丙申，片刻耽误不得。

9001390.en: I was actually an Alliance Guard myself when I was young. During a battle against the Wave of Monsters, I was heavily wounded and sent back to the Alliance. The Indica Rice Manager gave me a bowl of indica rice. My body was weak, but after eating the indica rice, I recovered my Energy and Stamina quickly.
9001390.ch: 其实我年轻之时亦是仙卫。一次兽潮之战，我受了重伤被送回仙盟。当时的玉籼之主给我递来一碗米饭，我身体不怎么好，但吃了玉籼制成的米饭，竟然很快就生出精力。

9001391.en: I was afraid of fighting the monsters, but that bowl of indica rice gave me the courage...
9001391.ch: 本来我有点害怕到外面与妖兽战斗，但那碗玉籼仿佛给了我勇气……

9001392.en: I later asked him to teach me how to grow indica rice. I want to grow better rice to restore Energy and Vitality for every Alliance Guard returning from fierce battles...
9001392.ch: 那以后，我找机会拜了玉籼的主人为师向他学习种植玉籼的法子。我要种出更好的稻米，给每一个恶战回来的仙卫补充灵力体力……

9001393.en: I hope one day we will defeat Xingtian and bring peace to Chi You. Then I will be able to focus on growing indica rice. I will grow enough indica rice to feed all the people in this world, and everyone will have enough Energy... And there won't be any more conflicts...
9001393.ch: 希望有朝一日，我们能战胜刑天，了却赤幽州的大事。那时我就可以真正专心种植玉籼了。我要让八荒之人都吃上玉籼，这样大家就不会缺灵力……就不会起争端……

9001394.en: Wei He falls asleep. Yuan'er returns to his house and tells you she has taken care of Wei He's fields.
9001394.ch: 卫禾说着说着就睡了过去。鸢儿此时回到屋内，给你说已经处理好卫禾的大片玉籼。

9001395.en: Shall we go? Well, do you think Wei He will grow Premium Indica Rice successfully?
9001395.ch: 我们走吧？唉，你说，老卫可以成功种出玉籼丙申么？

9001396.ch: 嗯！老卫一定可以种出来的！

9001397.en: Wei He invited you and me to his place? You wanna go together?
9001397.ch: 话说，老卫竟邀你和我去他那边？你要不要和我走一趟？

9001398.en: You and Gu Yuan'er arrive at Wei He's fields again. With your recent help, Wei He is looking much better now.
9001398.ch: 你与顾鸢儿再次去到卫禾的田地。经过鸢儿和你近日的帮助，卫禾气色已经好了不少。

9001399.en: Could you please spray some Energy in my fields today? I have something else to tend to!
9001399.ch: 能不能麻烦你们两位帮我去田里撒撒灵力？我还有事情要忙！

9001401.en: Gu Yuan'er and you fuel Wei He's fields with Energy, and the indica rice grow more lively. Wei He approaches you with two food boxes in his hands. He gives you and Gu Yuan'er one each.
9001401.ch: 顾鸢儿和你为卫禾的田地补充了灵力，田里的玉籼得到滋养显得十分精神；此时卫禾笑嘻嘻捧来两个食盒，他将之分别交到你与顾鸢儿手中。

9001402.en: Taken aback, Yuan'er opens the food box and tastes the food inside.
9001402.ch: 鸢儿呆了呆，打开手中食盒并将里面食物放入嘴里尝试。

9001404.en: Yes. This is the first harvest of the new rice! I want you to taste it first!
9001404.ch: 不错。这是收回的第一茬新米！我特意带来给你们尝尝。

9001406.en: I must thank you and Yuan'er for helping me all these days. Please take this.
9001406.ch: 除了鸢儿也要多谢你。这段日子里你总和鸢儿来帮助我，感激不尽。这个是给你的。

9001407.en: I have fully recovered, and I'll continue to grow better indica rice. Come around and lend me a hand in the future if you can find the time!
9001407.ch: 现今我身体已经好了，我要继续培植更好的玉籼。若是有空，也请你们常来帮我！

9001408.en: Wei He's food box is very delicious. The rice is soft and smooth, and it generates a warm stream of air within you that makes you feel energetic and powerful.
9001408.ch: 卫禾的食盒十分美味。白米软糯与爽口之感兼而有之。更奇的是食用之后，体内生出一股阳和之气周流全身，让你感觉精神充沛，仿佛有使不尽的力气。

9001409.en: You follow the direction and find the isolated monsters wandering behind the Alliance territory. Take them out now?
9001409.ch: 你依仙盟给出信息找到游荡在仙盟后方的零丁妖兽，是否立即将其消灭?

9001410.en: You have defeated these isolated wandering monsters. This area is safe now.
9001410.ch: 你消灭这些游荡的零丁妖兽，仙盟后方已暂时平安。

9001414.en: Jinghong drags you over. A monster jumps out from the side, but Jinghong seems prepared. He points his finger at it, and the monster is blasted into ashes with a huge noise.
9001414.ch: 景弘将你拉了过去。同时一只妖兽从旁扑出，不过景弘似乎早有准备。他伸指一点，前方猛发一声巨响，妖兽瞬间炸为齑粉。

9001415.en: It seems to be the smell of that monster that attracted more of them. But it's good news in a way. We can take the chance to eliminate all the monsters behind the Alliance territory.
9001415.ch: 这地方似乎残留了那妖兽的气息，导致群妖聚集。不过这也不错，解决了仙盟要肃清的后方妖兽。

9001416.en: My master was committed to finding the truth behind the Nether Mountains and the Nether Air. As his apprentice, I will inherit the mantle. That's why I came to Chi You after the Nether Mountains of Wayward Desert had collapsed.
9001416.ch: 先师曾立志探明冥山及冥气的一切因由，我作为徒弟的自然要秉承他的遗志。因此迷途荒漠冥山崩缺之后，我也来到赤幽州中。

9001417.en: To tell you the truth, my master once recorded that many years ago monster Dafeng touched the Nether Mountains by accident. As a result, it was corrupted by the Nether Air and became extremely ferocious. Somehow it seemed to have arrived in Chi You too.
9001417.ch: 实不相瞒。先师昔日笔记之中曾记录多年以前，曾有妖兽大风误触冥山，被冥气侵蚀，变得暴躁邪戾。而大风似乎亦因故来到赤幽州中。

9001418.en: I suspect monster Dafeng once stayed here... But why? Oh, you may go back to the Alliance first. I want to stay here to investigate more.
9001418.ch: 我怀疑大风妖兽曾在此处停留栖息……不过这是为什么呢？啊，道友先回去仙盟好了。在下还想在此处查探一番。

9001419.en: Dafeng... Is it... No, I need more evidence...
9001419.ch: 大风……难道是在……不，还得再有一些佐证才能确定……

9001420.en: You're here? You must have accepted the mission to eliminate monsters behind the Alliance territory. Please stay at my side.
9001420.ch: 道友你来了？想必你是为仙盟击杀后方妖兽才来到此处。请你待在我身边稍等。

9001421.en: Jinghong drags you behind him. Suddenly, a monster appears in front of you. Jinghong chants a spell, and with blinding white light, the monster is vaporized, leaving a deep hole where it stood.
9001421.ch: 景弘才将你拉到他身后，一只妖兽突然出现在前方。景弘嘴里念了个咒诀，前方白光大盛，妖兽瞬间被蒸发，只留下深坑一个。

9001422.en: My friend, I suspect this deep hole to be one of Dafeng's lairs.
9001422.ch: 道友，我怀疑炸开的地底深坑即是大风其中一个存身之处。

9001423.en: It must have struggled in this deep hole. But why?
9001423.ch: 大风曾在这个深坑之中辛苦挣扎，这是为什么？

9001424.en: Sorry, I was lost in memories... The monster behind the Alliance territory has been killed. You may go back to report to the Alliance.
9001424.ch: 看我只顾思索当年妖兽的情形……后方出没的妖兽已被我杀死，道友回去告知仙盟即可。

9001425.en: My friend, could you lend me your help again?
9001425.ch: 道友，请再助景弘一臂之力好么？

9001426.en: I found a battleground behind us with Mulberry Branch Fragments... I want to take some of them home to study.
9001426.ch: 在下发现后方有一个斗场，里面遗留一些扶桑枝碎屑……而我希望取得这些碎屑好细细研究。

9001427.en: Monsters were once spotted here, so I hope you could stay on guard here. I'll be back soon.
9001427.ch: 仙盟曾在此处发现妖兽，因此希望道友在外守望，景弘去去就回。

9001428.en: Jinghong arrives at the destination and picks up a branch on the ground when a monster appears out of nowhere. He thrusts at the monster with the branch, and the monster swells and explodes...
9001428.ch: 景弘进入前面山坳，他刚从地上拾起断枝，妖兽便突然出现。景鸿忙以树枝刺向对手。而妖兽被断枝击中，瞬间膨胀炸裂……

9001429.en: That's it... My master once wrote that monster Dafeng touched the Nether Mountains by accident. As a result, it was corrupted by the Nether Air, but it didn't lose its consciousness. It stayed for some time behind the Alliance territory.
9001429.ch: 果然是这样……先师记载，妖兽大风误触冥山，它在冥山沾染冥气遭受侵蚀。大风被冥气侵蚀后似乎并未丧失原本意志，它在仙盟后方停留过一段日子。

9001430.en: I think monster Dafeng was resisting the invasion of Nether Air. But later on, someone fought a fierce battle with Dafeng here and wounded it with an arrow made of a Mulberry Branch.
9001430.ch: 依我估计，妖兽大风应在对抗冥气入侵。不过后来有人在此地与大风恶战，似乎最后还凭扶桑枝制成的箭伤了大风。

9001431.en: My master always thought Mulberry Branches were only grown in Hua Feng, and it was also the Mulberry Branch from the Divine Mulberry in the East Sea that helped Hou Yi shoot down the Three-legged Crow. Seems there was more to that story.
9001431.ch: 师父一直认为扶桑枝是华封州之物，后羿亦在东海扶桑树得到扶桑枝而射落三足乌，看来情况不尽如此啊。

9001432.en: By the way, the active monsters here have long been the targets of the Alliance. Now that they have been killed by the Mulberry Branch, please go back and report to the Alliance.
9001432.ch: 对了，这边活跃的妖兽仙盟早有意向将之除去，现在已被扶桑断枝击杀，也烦请道友报知仙盟吧。

9001433.en: The disciple that went insane due to Xingtian waving his axe is just over there. Knock him out and bring him back?
9001433.ch: 因刑天挥动战斧而失控的仙盟弟子就在前方，是否立即将其击倒带回？

9001434.en: You knock out the disciple, and the Alliance sends someone to bring him back. This accident is over.
9001434.ch: 你将该名弟子击倒后，仙盟亦派出成员前来接应，将这名弟子带走。此事总算告一段落。

9001436.en: You approach the insane Alliance Guard and intend to take him back for treatment, but he turns around to attack you. Suddenly, with a flash of white light in the air, the Alliance Guard is knocked down to the ground.
9001436.ch: 你接近失控仙卫打算将之带回医治，不料仙卫竟突然回头攻你。此时半空中白光一闪，仙卫瞬间被击倒在地。

9001437.en: My friend, I'll take this Alliance Guard back. You only need to go back and report to the Alliance.
9001437.ch: 道友，该名仙卫便由本座带回即可。请你只告知仙盟你已完成任务。

9001438.en: Nan Zhen, take this Alliance Guard to my place. This accident may have something to do with Jiuying...
9001438.ch: 南真，将该名仙卫带到我处。此事或与九婴有关……

9001440.en: The insane disciple notices you and turns around to pounce on you. Suddenly, Nan Zhen appears and knocks out the disciple...
9001440.ch: 前方失控弟子察觉到你的接近，他只一回头便朝你扑来。不过南真突然出手将其击倒制服……

9001441.en: Alliance Master said he would heal this Alliance Guard himself. Thanks to you, this guard was caught. I'll take him back. Goodbye.
9001441.ch: 盟主有令，要亲自为这名仙卫医治。道友协助捉住此人，仙盟当记你一功。人，我先带走了，告辞。

9001442.ch: 那……真的是刑天影响的么……

9001443.en: You approach the insane Alliance Guard, but Nan Zhen knocks out the disciple before you act...
9001443.ch: 你接近失控仙卫，不料南真抢先出手将仙卫击倒拿下……

9001445.en: *cough* Thanks for your help. This disciple is in a strange condition. I'll take him back for treatment. You may go back and report to the Alliance as usual.
9001445.ch: 咳！多谢道友援手，这名失控弟子情形特异，在下先带走医治了。道友照常回报仙盟即可。

9001446.en: He...is really a handful... He... What! It's not Xingtian! Why has he gone insane?!
9001446.ch: 这人……真难对付……他……这！不是刑天！他为什么会失控？！

9001447.en: Nan Zhen is checking the insane Alliance Guard when Alliance Master walks up behind him. With hands clasped behind his back, he looks at Nan Zhen silently. He also sees you and walks up to you smilingly.
9001447.ch: 南真正在细细查看那名失控仙卫，而此时盟主亦慢慢来到南真身后。他双手负在背后，一言不发的看着南真。同时他察觉到身后的你，于是笑吟吟的朝你看来。

9001448.en: My friend, I'll take care of this Alliance Guard myself. You may go back and report to the one who gave you the mission.
9001448.ch: 道友好，这名仙卫便由本座亲自医治好了。请你回去告知仙盟发布委托之人。

9001449.en: Nan Zhen, take the guard back now. He will not be able to fully recover if he's treated too late.
9001449.ch: 南真，还不将仙卫带走？耽误了医治，没准便要落下病根。

9001451.en: My friend, our Alliance is shorthanded these days. Please lend us your help.
9001451.ch: 道友，眼下正是用人之际，还请多为仙盟出力。

9001452.en: You search carefully and finally find the Alliance Guard who is giving off dense Nether Air. This guard has lost the human form under the erosion of the Nether Air...
9001452.ch: 经过你细细寻找，终于找到那名浑身散发冥气的仙卫。此人身周冥气狂冒，已不复人形模样。

9001453.en: A monster that has a human form is much more difficult to handle. You kill the monster and remove a threat to the Alliance.
9001453.ch: 能够幻化人形的妖兽对付起来总是十分棘手，你击杀此妖，终于为仙盟除去大患。

9001455.en: Feng Yunchuo defeats an Alliance Guard who is giving off Nether Air. The guard lies down for a while before transforming into a monster, and a voice is heard in the air...
9001455.ch: 风允婼出手击败一名散发冥气的仙卫。该仙卫伏到在地不多时化为一只妖兽形态，此时半空中一个声音响起……

9001456.en: You...have Nether Air... You're one of us...

9001459.en: Most of our tribesmen are corrupted by Nether Air, and our bodies have something in common with the monsters now. That's why it mistook me for one of them...
9001459.ch: 我族之人大半均被冥气侵蚀，体质已与这妖类相似，估计由此错认……

9001460.en: Feng Yunchuo, who has always been stern and confident, looks so troubled and hesitant now...
9001460.ch: 风允婼往日神情坚毅，举手投足均是充满自信，但目前神情竟生出一丝疑惑……

9001461.en: Hero, please excuse me... Please go back to the Alliance and report about the Alliance Guard...
9001461.ch: 恩人，风某先行告辞……仙卫之事相烦回报仙盟……

9001462.en: How did these monsters disguised as Alliance Guards sneak behind the Alliance territory?
9001462.ch: 这些妖兽变成的仙卫究竟是怎样进入仙盟后方的？

9001463.en: Feng Yunchuo has knocked down the monster that infiltrated the Alliance disguised as an Alliance Guard. While dying, it whispers a few words in Feng Yunchuo's ear, which leave him in shock.
9001463.ch: 风允婼已将近日潜入仙盟伪装仙卫的妖兽击倒擒下。这只妖兽垂死之际凑近风允婼低声说了几句话，风允婼竟因此神色大变。

9001464.en: No, it was right. Our tribesmen are neither humans nor monsters now. We can hardly be accepted by the cultivators...
9001464.ch: 不，这妖兽说得不错。我族非人非妖，确是难为修仙者所容……

9001465.en: *sigh* I have gone to many places in search of a solution to rid our tribesmen of the suffering from the Nether Air, but only in vain.
9001465.ch: 唉……风某四处奔走，只为族人脱去冥气侵蚀之苦。只可惜至仍旧一事无成。

9001466.en: The monster disguised as the Alliance Guard has been slain. Please go back to report to the Alliance...
9001466.ch: 伪装仙卫之妖已然伏诛，还请恩人代为转告仙盟……

9001468.en: Feng Yunchuo is fighting a monster, but he seems to have been distracted by the monster's words. The monster takes the chance to pounce on him, but Feng Yunchuo manages to kill the monster with his superior strength.
9001468.ch: 风允婼正与一只妖兽对峙，不过他似乎受了妖物的言语竟致失神；妖兽借此良机猛扑而前，所幸风允婼实力强悍，终于反杀此妖。

9001469.en: Hero, you're here? It was so embarrassing for me to be distracted by the monster.
9001469.ch: 恩人来了？区区妖兽，竟使风某狼狈至此，叫恩人笑话了。

9001471.en: I'm...fine... What are you doing here? You'd better go home. It's too dangerous here.
9001471.ch: 没……没事……你来这边做什么？回去吧，太危险了。

9001473.en: Hero... Our Chief has often been absent-minded these days. We were so worried, so we discussed with the young master and followed him...
9001473.ch: 恩人……近日族长时常失魂落魄。我们十分担心，跟少主商量后，便跟了过来……

9001474.en: Chief has gone afar. I'd better catch up with him. Excuse me!
9001474.ch: 族长去得远了，我有点放心不下，失陪！

9001476.en: Feng Yunchuo is fighting an Alliance Guard who is giving off Nether Air. The guard suddenly transforms into a monster to attack Feng Yunchuo. Chief Feng seems to be shocked and stands still in face of the attack.
9001476.ch: 前方风允婼正与一个散发冥气的仙卫对峙。这名仙卫突然变成妖兽攻往风允婼。风族长似乎心神受到震动，面对袭击，竟是无动于衷。

9001477.en: His demon subordinate steps up to parry the attack on Feng Yunchuo.
9001477.ch: 他身边的魔族下属见状扑出为风允婼挡下一击。

9001479.en: Feng Yunchuo is infuriated by his tribesman's wound. He swings a punch and breaks the monster disguised as an Alliance Guard into several segments...
9001479.ch: 风允婼眼族人受伤，瞬间变得十分气愤。他挥出一拳，将冒充仙卫的妖兽打成数截……

9001481.en: I'm...fine... I only need to lie in bed for a month. Haha, that...is the Chief I knew!
9001481.ch: 没……没事……躺个把月就好了。哈哈，这……这才是我们老大该有的风采啊！

9001482.en: *sigh* You take some rest first... I'll take you back to the camp...
9001482.ch: 唉……你先歇息一下……我带你回族中……

9001483.en: I've been distracted by the monsters lately... If it was not for my tribesman who saved me, I had forgotten why I came here...
9001483.ch: 近日风某竟让这些妖孽三言两语以致失魂落魄……若非族人挺身救我，风某竟忘了来到这里的目的……

9001484.en: *sigh* I won't hesitate again as long as I can protect my people!
9001484.ch: 唉，从今以后，只要能保护族人，风某便再不迟疑了。

9001485.en: By the way, I think these monsters are under the command of someone behind the scenes...
9001485.ch: 对了，风某以为，这些妖兽其实有指挥者暗中调度……

9001486.en: For the moment they may only be sending monsters disguised as Alliance Guards to infiltrate the Alliance, but it's very likely they will come up with more threatening new strategies...
9001486.ch: 眼下它们只派遣妖兽伪装仙卫渗透仙盟，但想来日必有更多手段叫我们防不胜防……

9001487.en: The Mythical Beast is roaring with its mouth open, through which gusts of Nether Air are spurted out. It's a tough enemy. You're going to...
9001487.ch: 前方大妖兽正张口呼啸，大股冥气从此妖口中喷涌而出。此妖不易对付，你要……

9001488.en: You kill the monster, and the Nether Air gradually dissipates. This area is safe now.
9001488.ch: 你击杀此妖后，附近冥气渐渐消失。仙盟后方亦同时恢复安定。

9001489.en: Such dense Nether Air... There must be a monster breathing nearby.
9001489.ch: 这浓重的冥气……想必这附近定有妖兽吐息。

9001490.en: You arrive near the Nether Air and find Sunny fighting with the Mythical Beast. At a disadvantage, it suddenly swells and explodes, and Nether Air surges and spreads. Sunny waves her sleeve, and the Nether Air dissipates in an instant, but it leaves her weakened and pale...
9001490.ch: 你赶到冥气附近的时候，圣阳正与大妖兽恶战。落在下风的妖兽突然膨胀炸裂，冥气冲天而起，朝四周扩散。而圣阳袖子一扬，四散的冥气立即消失停止。但圣阳施法之后似乎一阵虚弱，甚至脸色都白了……

9001491.en: I'm...fine... These monsters are too strong... I promised the Elder to dispel the Nether Air, so I must keep my promise...
9001491.ch: 没……没事……这些妖兽也太厉害了……既答应长老驱散冥气，总得言而有信才是……

9001493.en: The noise of a fierce battle is heard ahead. You raise your eyes and see Sunny fighting a monster shrouded in a mist of Nether Air.
9001493.ch: 前方传来激战的动静，抬眼看去，圣阳正与一只身萦冥雾的妖兽剧斗。

9001494.en: After killing the monster, Sunny opens her mouth and breathes out a fragrant wind, and the Nether Air nearby dissipates in an instant. But Sunny faints and falls down to the ground.
9001494.ch: 圣阳击杀妖兽后，小嘴一张，香风吐出，周围留存的冥气瞬间散去。不过驱散冥气后，圣阳竟也力竭软倒。

9001496.en: Yes, you're right. The monsters' Nether Air in Chi You is endless. It's impossible to dispel all the Nether Air.
9001496.ch: 嗯，你说得不错。这赤幽州中妖兽冥气几乎无穷无尽，一直驱散冥气，果然还是勉强了点。

9001497.en: Thunder is heard ahead, and a column of Nether Air surges up to the sky...
9001497.ch: 远方突然发出轰鸣，一道冥气冲上半空，几乎与天相接……

9001498.en: Sunny gently waves her sleeve, and sunlight pierces the clouds to reach the land. After a while, the dense Nether Air starts to dissipate, but a lot of monsters appear around her...
9001498.ch: 只见圣阳轻拂衣袖，天上阳光刺破重云，洒落地面。片刻后，泛滥的冥气终于渐渐遏止。圣阳正在竭力驱散冥气，不过此时她身周出现大量妖兽……

9001500.en: Sunny doesn't reply. She struggles up and limps away...
9001500.ch: 圣阳没有回话，她挣扎起来，一拐一拐的走远了……

9001501.en: You see Sunny moving slowly ahead...
9001501.ch: 只见前方赤阳正在缓缓前行……

9001502.en: Sunny slowly approaches a monster who is breathing out Nether Air and hurls an arrow of light to pierce through it. It dies and Nether Air drifts up from its corpse. Sunny waves her sleeve to dissipate it.
9001502.ch: 圣阳正慢慢接近一只吐出冥气的妖兽，然后举手投出一支光箭，扎穿妖兽。那妖兽死后散发冥气，圣阳随即挥动袖子将之驱散。

9001503.en: You are late. I have already killed the monster.
9001503.ch: 你来慢了。妖兽已被我击杀。

9001504.en: With this said, Sunny suddenly collapses onto the ground. You have no choice but to take her to a safe cave nearby to rest.
9001504.ch: 圣阳说完，竟然突然晕倒在地。你唯有将她先带到附近安全的洞窟之中稍事休息。

9001506.en: The separation of my soul back then cost me too much Energy, and I have barely one-tenth of my previous power now... And these days I spent a lot of Energy dissipating the Nether Air...
9001506.ch: 当年元神分离终究耗去我太多灵力，眼下修为还不及从前十分之一……近日又接连透支体内灵力驱散冥气……

9001507.en: Yong Ning once suffered because of me, and later hero Hou Yi died because of me...
9001507.ch: 昔日我先让永宁州蒙受灾难，后又叫英雄后羿因我而死……

9001508.en: I was supposed to make a contribution to the world, but I only caused disasters to it. Perhaps coming to the Alliance is my chance to redeem myself...
9001508.ch: 天地生我，乃为有所作为。不想我却倒行逆施，酿起这样大的灾祸。或者来到仙盟，正是我补救的机会……

9001509.en: You never knew Sunny was so remorseful over her past. After confiding it to you, she seems to have recovered a bit. She stands up, looks into the distance, and takes her leave with a sigh.
9001509.ch: 你从未想过圣阳竟是这样自责。圣阳倾诉一阵后，似已恢复元气。她站了起来目视远方，片刻后叹了口气渐渐走远。

9001510.en: A monster beyond the wall is patrolling and observing the Alliance. It's a scout. We must kill it before it collects information about the Alliance.
9001510.ch: 城墙之外的妖兽正在徘徊观察远方仙盟，此妖查探我仙盟底细，务必除去。

9001511.en: You kill the monster and remove a threat to the Alliance.
9001511.ch: 你击杀此兽，已为仙盟除去外患。

9001512.en: My friend, it's dangerous beyond the wall!
9001512.ch: 道友，城墙之外十分危险！

9001513.en: My friend, do you still remember me, Alliance Library Manager Mu Kuiyuan? I know you are going to kill monsters out there, so I came and waited for you here.
9001513.ch: 道友，还记得仙盟百城殿之主沐窥圆么？我知道你要为仙盟外出铲除妖兽，因此已经先你一步来到此处。

9001514.en: I have consulted Alliance documents, and it is said that monsters are so sly that they would detonate the Nether Air within them to bring down their enemies with them as the last resort...
9001514.ch: 在下曾经查阅仙盟记录，妖兽奸诈狡猾，若是抵敌不过很可能会引动自身冥气炸裂躯体与对手同归于尽……

9001515.en: Suddenly, a monster pounces on Mu Kuiyuan, but he has soon gained the upper hand. Just as he is about to kill the monster, it gives a roar and explodes by itself. Luckily, Mu Kuiyuan is quick in reaction and dodges the explosion.
9001515.ch: 此时一只妖兽扑出与沐窥圆战作一起，不过沐窥圆很快就占住上风，眼看正要一举击杀妖物。不想对手突然发出长啸自爆。所幸沐窥圆见机极快，千钧一发之际还是避了开去。

9001516.en: *cough* Monsters... I said I was not good at fighting them... My friend, now you have seen it... You should be very careful in the future... *cough*
9001516.ch: 咳咳……好妖怪……我就说自己不擅长与妖兽战斗……道友，现今你知道了……日后可要处处小心……咳咳……

9001517.en: My friend, don't go any further... Come over here. I have found the untamed scout for you.
9001517.ch: 道友，不要再深入了……来我这边，我已经替你找到妖族哨探了。

9001518.en: My friend, the untamed are not as simple as you think. They will use evil arts to bewilder you and then interrogate you.
9001518.ch: 道友，这些妖族并不似你想的那样简单。他们会使邪法让你失去神智，然后再行逼问之事。

9001519.en: My friend, I used to be an Alliance Guard when I was young. A monster used the Nether Air to bewilder me, and since then I was unable to fight beyond the wall. It is very dangerous out there!
9001519.ch: 道友，我年轻之时曾为仙卫，便是因为这妖兽使冥气令我失去神智，我才再不到城墙之外参与战斗的。外面，实在凶险！

9001520.en: Mu Kuiyuan tells you his experience and then casts an art to ignite the monster, which explodes into ashes...
9001520.ch: 沐窥圆对你进行规劝之后，便使动术法点燃妖兽，那妖兽瞬间炸裂，化为飞灰一缕……

9001521.en: *sigh*... I'm not strong enough to protect you should you run into trouble. Let's go back to the Alliance.
9001521.ch: 唉……我学艺不精，道法浅薄……道友若遇重大危险，便无法保护，这便回去吧？

9001522.en: My friend, it's me, Alliance Library Manager Mu Kuiyuan. Come over here. I have captured a monster!
9001522.ch: 道友，是我，仙盟百城殿主事沐窥圆。你过来，我已抓住这妖兽哨探了！

9001523.en: My friend, a wise man should not stand near a dilapidated wall. I suggest you return behind the wall immediately.
9001523.ch: 道友，君子不立危墙之下。听我一劝，快快回入城墙内。

9001524.en: Monsters launch attacks with their Nether Air, and we cultivators manipulate our Martial Arts with Energy.
9001524.ch: 我跟你说，妖兽以冥气发动攻势，我等修仙者则凭灵力控制功法。

9001525.en: But the blending of Nether Air and Qi can result in devastating power. We can easily get involved...
9001525.ch: 但冥灵二气一旦交汇很有可能发生强大力量，我们身处其中，一不小心便会受到波及……

9001526.en: Mu Kuiyuan is about to explain more thoroughly when the monster knocked down on the ground jumps up again. Taken aback, Mu Kuiyuan launches Energy to attack the monster, and the blending of Nether Air and Qi indeed results in an explosion that blasts the monster to ashes...
9001526.ch: 沐窥圆还待解释，地上被他拿下的妖兽突然暴起。沐窥圆大吃一惊，忙发出灵力攻击妖兽，冥灵二气交汇之下，果然发生爆炸，将那妖兽炸为齑粉……

9001527.en: *cough* I knew something like this would happen... My friend, it's very dangerous out here. Let's go back to the Alliance! *cough*
9001527.ch: 咳咳……我就知道会这样……道友，危险，回去吧！咳咳！咳咳！

9001528.en: I'm Mu Kuiyuan, a weak cultivator not good at fighting monsters. Please come over here...
9001528.ch: 在下是道法肤浅，不擅长与妖兽战斗的沐窥圆，请你过来……

9001529.en: *sigh* Why don't you heed my warning? Though I still can't remember your name, I often see you heading outside, and I'm really worried about you.
9001529.ch: 唉……你怎么就是不听了呢？虽然我至今不记得道友名字，但你老是往外闯，实在很叫我担心。

9001530.en: How about you come to my Library? You can work for the Alliance without risking your life out there. What do you say?
9001530.ch: 不如你来我百城殿吧？既能为仙盟办事，又不必在外冒险，岂非一举两得？

9001531.en: You know I'm not good at fighting monsters. We don't need to study Taoist in my Library. Life there is much easier.
9001531.ch: 而且你看我这么不擅长与妖物对战就知道了，百城殿是不必苦研道法的，别说多轻松了。

9001532.en: Mu Kuiyuan is about to continue his persuasion when three Mythical Beasts appear out of nowhere. He is surprised, but he quickly casts Martial Arts so devastating that it shakes the sky and the earth. Those three monsters must have become ashes now...
9001532.ch: 沐窥圆还待劝说，你们身边突然出现三只大妖兽。沐窥圆面露讶色，忙拈个法诀发出功法。功法威力震天动地，扬起极大尘头。想必三只妖物已然骨肉成泥……

9001533.en: So would you like to join my Library? You will be warmly welcomed! Well, it's so dangerous out here. I'd better go back to my Library and stay there reading books!
9001533.ch: 你来百城殿吧？我们的大门永为你开着！不说了，这实在太可怕了，我还是先回百城殿看书吧！

9001535.en: This cave is swarming with monsters. We must clear this cave lest it serves as a stronghold for an invading Wave of Monsters.
9001535.ch: 洞穴之中果然充斥妖物，若不肃清此巢，日后兽潮大举来犯，必为大患。

9001536.en: You sweep the cave and kill all the monsters.
9001536.ch: 你对兽穴进行一番扫荡，已将群妖消灭。

9001537.en: My friend, would you tag along with me to explore the monster lair?
9001537.ch: 道友，不知可愿与景弘一探妖兽巢穴？

9001538.en: Jinghong leads you into a large cave unlike an ordinary lair for monsters. In the cave are a heap of fallen monsters.
9001538.ch: 景弘带着你进入洞穴，只见这个洞穴十分庞大，不像一般妖兽栖息之穴。而里面亦只躺着一堆一动不动的妖兽。

9001539.en: Don't worry. I have killed them, so it's safe here.
9001539.ch: 不必惊慌，妖兽已被我击杀，这里面十分安全。

9001540.en: According to my investigation, this cave has been here for a long time.
9001540.ch: 我发现这洞窟生成以来已有相当久远的年岁。

9001541.en: So what kind of monster has been staying here in such a large cave?
9001541.ch: 这么庞大的洞窟究竟是谁什么妖物留住里面呢？

9001542.en: Do you have any idea? Haha, sorry, I was lost in thought again. Let's go back to the Alliance now. There can be dangers as long as we are beyond the wall.
9001542.ch: 道友可有头绪？哈，景弘又犯痴了。我们赶紧回去吧，待在城墙外毕竟不太平。

9001543.ch: 唔，里面这片桃林究竟是……

9001544.en: My friend, you are here just in time. I have killed the monster in this cave, but it's a little strange over here...
9001544.ch: 道友，来得好，这边内穴的妖物景弘已出手击杀，不过这里面有点奇怪……

9001545.en: Jinghong steps aside and shows you the inside of the cave. Apart from the killed monsters, there are some peach trees in it. On the earth are some fallen petals that have merged with the soil, giving off a strange smell.
9001545.ch: 景弘让过身子给你看向内洞。这片洞穴之中除去已被击杀的妖兽，还有一小片桃树，树上叶瓣落地，化为花泥，发出阵阵异味。

9001547.en: Well, it seems to be the Divine Forest... I've heard about dead giants' bodies nurturing peach trees... Was this giant cave the lair of the giants?
9001547.ch: 嗯，这仿佛就是邓林……在下听说巨人一族故世之后一身骨肉化为滋养，能育桃林……这巨大洞穴莫非就是巨人栖身之处……

9001548.en: What were the giants doing here? It's completely beyond me.
9001548.ch: 巨人来此是为了什么？这却叫人想不明白。

9001549.en: This...is the eleventh... Why... What on earth...
9001549.ch: 这……已是第十一个了……为什么……他们究竟……

9001550.en: Look. The Alliance has been searching for the hidden caves in Chi You to cull the monsters, and I found a lot of giant caves like this while hunting monsters out here.
9001550.ch: 道友，请看。仙盟为了抵御兽潮，不断查探赤幽州外的隐秘洞穴；我为仙盟除妖之余亦在外查探，却找到好多这样的巨型洞穴……

9001551.en: Jinghong leads you deeper along the path, and you arrive at a giant cave.
9001551.ch: 景弘带着你沿路深入，不多时一个巨型洞穴展现眼前。

9001552.en: In this cave is also a small peach forest... This...is where they died...
9001552.ch: 洞中亦有小片桃林……这……是他们登遐故世之所……

9001553.en: If this was the lair of the giants... Why did they come to Chi You one after another?
9001553.ch: 道友，如果这是巨人昔日栖息之地……那么为何他们一个个都要来到赤幽州中？

9001554.en: *sigh* If my master were still alive, he would definitely find out the truth... Master...
9001554.ch: 唉……先师若在定能参透这里面的玄机……师父……

9001556.en: My friend, please follow me. I have killed the monsters in the cave. It's safe here.
9001556.ch: 道友，请随我来，洞中妖兽景弘已出手击杀，里面十分安全。

9001557.en: Jinghong leads you ahead, and it is indeed a giant cave, possibly once the lair of the giants. There is a peach forest in the cave. Jinghong takes a look around and picks a peach from one of the trees.
9001557.ch: 景弘带着你进入洞穴，这里面果然又是一个巨大的洞穴，相信又是巨人族栖身的洞窟。洞中有数片桃林；景弘四处张望一下，便跑了下去摘了一个嫣红的果子。

9001558.en: How odd this fruit is not corrupted by the Nether Air in this cave. What's more, it's teeming with Qi!
9001558.ch: 这果子长于洞中，竟未沾染半分冥气。果实之中还分明充斥灵气。实在十分神奇。

9001559.en: My friend, this fruit can be helpful to us cultivators. Please take it.
9001559.ch: 道友，这果子于我等修仙者颇有益处。请收下。

9001560.en: It has a pleasant aroma and taste. You swallow it and feel powerful all over your body.
9001560.ch: 果实入口十分清香。你服食之后，但觉身体充满力量。

9001561.en: You arrive at the destination to set spells. They will kill any monster upon touch.
9001561.ch: 你前往指定地点布置阵法符咒，此后若有妖兽从此踏入，必定灰飞烟灭。

9001562.en: You are about to set spells when a large number of monsters appear and surround you.
9001562.ch: 你正打算布置符咒，未料突然涌出大量妖物围攻于你。

9001563.en: You set spells after killing the monsters. These spells will kill any monster upon touch.
9001563.ch: 你消灭妖兽后，立即布置阵法；此后若有妖物踏入此处，定然触发禁咒，化为齑粉。

9001564.en: The monster crawling ahead is the one wanted by the Alliance. Fight it now to help Alliance Guards capture it?
9001564.ch: 前方伏地妖兽即为仙盟捕捉对象，是否出手将其击败以方便仙卫捕捉？

9001565.en: You defeat the monster to help Alliance Guards capture it. They are grateful for your help.
9001565.ch: 你击败妖兽，协助仙卫捕捉此妖。仙卫经历艰辛终于捕获妖物，对你百般道谢。

9001567.en: My friend, the monster ahead is a tough one... Let me help you.
9001567.ch: 道友，前方妖兽不易对付……我来助你吧。

9001568.en: The monster notices you and charges at you. However, Nan Zhen brings it down with a few simple moves...
9001568.ch: 妖兽察觉到你们的存在，竟朝你们攻来。而南真两下便将妖兽击倒……

9001569.en: My friend, I'll take this monster with me. You only need to go back and report to the Alliance.
9001569.ch: 道友，这只妖兽我先带回了。请你报知仙盟即可。

9001570.en: It's not enough... I must catch one more...
9001570.ch: 不合用么……我必须再拿下一只……

9001571.en: The monster wanted by the Alliance is just ahead, but Nan Zhen takes the initiative and brings it down...
9001571.ch: 仙盟所需擒获的妖兽便在前方，不过此时南真突然出手将妖兽击倒……

9001572.en: My friend, this monster is mine. You only need to go back and tell the Alliance that I will take it to them later.
9001572.ch: 道友，这只妖兽是在下先得了。道友只需报知仙盟妖兽由在下转交即可。

9001574.en: You are about to catch the monster, but Nan Zhen acts first and brings it down...
9001574.ch: 你想出手擒下妖兽，不过南真再次抢先出手将妖兽抓获……

9001575.en: I'm sorry. Please let me have this one... Your mission is complete.
9001575.ch: 对不住之至，这妖兽请先让给在下吧……道友的任务已完成了。

9001576.en: You see Nan Zhen ahead. He looks around and enters a cave after making sure no one is following him...
9001576.ch: 前方南真左右张望，他确认无人跟随后进入到一个洞穴之中……

9001577.en: Nan Zhen has entered the cave, and you are going to...

9001578.en: You enter the cave and find many iron cages with monsters locked inside. At the farther end of the cave is a stone table, but Nan Zhen is nowhere to be found...
9001578.ch: 你进入洞中，未料洞中放满铁笼，里面都囚禁着一只只妖兽。洞穴深处有一张石桌，而南真则不见踪影……

9001579.ch: 嗯，带一只妖兽回去交差……

9001580.en: On the stone table is a notebook that records where the monsters came from. To your surprise, it's the Alliance that captured them, and Nan Zhen transferred them here from the Alliance in secret...
9001580.ch: 石桌放有册子，上面记载了这些妖兽来历。而叫人始料不及的是，仙盟擒获这些妖兽，而南真却从仙盟处偷偷将妖兽转移到此处……

9001581.en: What is Nan Zhen up to...

9001582.en: It's not safe here. You'd better leave at once...
9001582.ch: 此地不宜久留，还是先行离开吧……

9001583.en: It feels eerie in the cave, and Nan Zhen is nowhere to be found...
9001583.ch: 洞穴透着一股诡异之感，而南真则不见踪影……

9001584.en: My friend, why did you come here?

9001585.en: The Master asks me to come here for the fight.

9001586.en: So it is. The Wave of Monsters is very dangerous. Please be careful.
9001586.ch: 原来如此。兽潮之患十分凶险，请阁下小心为上。

9001587.en: (Press the Repel Wave of Monsters button in the Monster Resisting Altar to enter the campaign.)
9001587.ch: （按下御妖台抵御兽潮按钮后即会进入兽潮之战。）

9001588.en: Recently, you often hear the two voices arguing in your mind, and they seem even more active than before...
9001588.ch: 最近那两个争辩的声音总在脑海里接连响起，而且变得越发频繁……

9001590.en: If I am gone, you will also disperse into the void. Come, I am waiting for you!
9001590.ch: 没有我，你也会消散……化为虚无，我等着，等着！！

9001592.en: Just after the two arguing voices faded away, you hear the roaring of Xingtian from distance. These days Xingtian wields his axe frequently with fierce roars, and Chi You is trembling under the threat.
9001592.ch: 脑海里争辩的声音才渐渐隐没，远方刑天又发出啸鸣。近日刑天频繁挥动战斧，接连嘶吼，赤幽州中笼罩在一股恐怖之中。

9001593.en: Master, recently Xingtian has raised his axe frequently, and some of our junior disciples have been affected and successively gone crazy... I was so worried that I came to you.
9001593.ch: 盟主，最近刑天频频举斧，仙盟一些修为稍低的弟子已受其影响，陆续疯魔……老身实在着急，便赶来找你。

9001594.en: Some ancient masters guessed that Xingtian's axe and shield are the symbols of two beliefs, one for slaughter and conquering, the other for defense and resistance.
9001594.ch: 前人曾有猜测，以为刑天盾斧贯彻某种信念，战斧充斥杀伐攻战之心，而盾牌则是防守克制之意。

9001595.en: Thus, once the axe is wielded, the intent for killing, along with Nether Air, will be spread to Chi You; monsters will also take this chance for invasion, and they could even form Wave of Monsters. The minor disciples in our Alliance will be affected as well...
9001595.ch: 因此战斧一旦挥舞，杀意随着冥气弥漫赤幽州，妖兽因此四处肆虐，甚至形成兽潮，我仙盟修为稍低的弟子亦会受此影响……

9001596.en: But, if the shield is held high, Chi You will enjoy some peaceful time. In my opinion, Xingtian is under the control of two contrasting minds, and these days, the control is on the verge of being destroyed...
9001596.ch: 但如举起盾牌，则州中无事。老身以为刑天似乎受两种意识操控，而近日巨人似已濒临失衡……

9001597.en: I intend to investigate his condition with a team of guards.
9001597.ch: 老身打算带领仙卫前往一探。

9001598.en: No, Elder, please don't do this! Let me go for it instead.
9001598.ch: 万万不可！长老！不如由奚照前往查探好了。

9001599.en: Absurd! How dare you arrange these in front of the Master? Go out!
9001599.ch: 放肆，盟主跟前岂容你自作主张，给我出去！

9001600.en: Elder, you must know that! The Nether Air around Xingtian is dense, and any creature approaching him will be suffocated. Now only our Master could enter...
9001600.ch: 长老，您知道的！刑天那边冥气之浓，人畜接近，立即窒息而亡，眼前只有盟主能够进入……

9001602.en: The threat of Xingtian is imminent. Now for the investigation, I'll pick ten elite guards to come there with me. If there were a chance, I would also try to slay him.
9001602.ch: 刑天之患已迫在眉睫，老身这便挑选十名精英仙卫前往调查刑天。若有机会，老身自当设法击杀刑天。

9001603.en: We still need to find a more comprehensive solution for it, and there is no need for acting hastily now.
9001603.ch: 此事仍需从长计议，长老不必急在一时。

9001605.en: The Nether Air is too dense around Xingtian. Certainly, you won't be able to approach him, just let me face our opponent instead.
9001605.ch: 刑天之前，冥气太重。你们无法接近，由我前往与之一决便是。

9001606.en: But Xingtian... is too powerful... If we can't figure out him... (Sigh) Well. I know.
9001606.ch: 刑天……实在太过强大……若不探明虚实……唉，老身知道了。

9001607.en: All Cultivators in the Alliance hold the same belief. Master, please don't get troubled by Xingtian. As long as I breathe, I will surely do my best to help you.
9001607.ch: 仙盟上下，一体同心。盟主不必为了刑天之事独自困扰。老身只要一息尚存，定尽力为盟主分忧。

9001608.en: You come before Xingtian. Sensing someone is approaching, he lifts his shield and axe. Then, the mouth on his belly lets out a roar.
9001608.ch: 你来到刑天面前。这巨人似乎察觉到对手接近，双手挥舞盾斧，继而腹部巨口一张，发出一声咆哮。

9001609.en: His roar disturbs your mind severely. Just at the time when you're trying to calm down, you feel a gale comes from above—the axe is chopping down on you.
9001609.ch: 这一声咆哮叫人心神大乱，正当你努力镇静之际，头顶罡风袭来，刑天已举斧朝你劈落。

9001610.en: The Energy you condensed as your shield was dispelled altogether by the pressure of Xingtian. There is no hope for you to dodge his attack, but you see a chilly flash of light come from somewhere far away, piercing the Nether Air on its way, and stabbing into the arm of Xingtian. The giant's arm got deterred briefly, and the blade of axe falls upon the ground near you, splitting the earth with horrible cracks.
9001610.ch: 你赖以防御的灵力被刑天发出的威压完全瓦解。眼看战斧避无可避，远处一道白光辟开冥气极速逼近，扎中刑天手臂。巨人手臂一顿，战斧落地稍偏，斩裂你身旁大片地面。

9001611.en: Then, before the dust blown up by the axe could settle, Xingtian lifts his weapon again for the second attack. At this critical moment, Luo Ying appears between you and Xingtian, Exorciser in hand.
9001611.ch: 战斧裂地激起的尘埃刚刚落定，刑天已再度举起武器朝你攻来，而骆瑛则手持辟魔锥挡在你与刑天之间。

9001612.en: Go back to the Alliance, then we talk about it! Master, don't get down easily!
9001612.ch: 回去仙盟，再作计较！盟主，遇事万勿轻易气馁！

9001613.en: Luo Ying points to you with a finger, and a warm flow suddenly envelops you. Then, she takes her Exorciser up, her eyes fixed on Xingtian.
9001613.ch: 骆瑛伸指一点，你瞬间被一股暖流包围。她则拿起手上辟魔锥，看向刑天。

9001614.en: You are teleported to somewhere else by the makeshift array, followed by some distant, deafening sounds. Then, you see Luo Ying is in the sky above you. Her figure is thrown into the air and falls somewhere not far from you after crashing upon two hills.
9001614.ch: 你被骆瑛临时结成的法阵传送到别处，同时远方传出几声轰鸣，之后骆瑛从天空飞过撞塌两座山峰栽落远处。

9001615.en: You find her lying among a pile of rubbles, heavily wounded. Her bones are shattered, and her Qi is in total disorder. Hearing your steps, she slowly opens her eyes and looks at you...
9001615.ch: 骆瑛奄奄一息的躺在一堆乱石之中，骨骼粉碎，气血逆流，她察觉到你走近勉强睁开了双眼，朝你看来……

9001616.en: Master... Do not fight him hastily...

9001617.en: Luo Ying faints as soon as she finished these words.
9001617.ch: 骆瑛话音刚落，便昏迷了过去……

9001618.en: Aunt... How did you get so badly hurt...
9001618.ch: 姑姑……你怎么伤得这么严重……

9001620.en: Master... Xingtian is a powerful opponent... Fight him with tactics... (Coughs)
9001620.ch: 盟主……刑天实在太过强大……切勿力敌……咳咳。

9001621.en: Aunt... please take a rest... now we should heal your wounds first...
9001621.ch: 姑姑……别说话了……眼下最紧要的是治好你的伤势……
